eight-e01.en: As modern society is becoming increasingly knowledge-intensive, it places a premium on an educated workforce (e.g., teachers, nurses, programmers), which can improve their financial security.
eight-e01.zh: 现代社会越来越依赖知识，因此高度重视受过教育的劳动者，例如教师、护士和程序员，这可以改善他们的经济保障。

eight-e01.en: This can put them in a stronger financial position than those taking up low-paid occupations, especially in the manufacturing industry or service sector, such as cleaning and catering.
eight-e01.zh: 这可以使他们比从事低薪职业的人处于更有利的经济地位，尤其是制造业或服务业中的清洁、餐饮等工作。

eight-e01.en: However, others point out that attending college does not necessarily amount to success in a professional career.
eight-e01.zh: 然而，另一些人指出，上大学并不一定等于事业成功。

eight-e01.en: In effect, multitudes of graduates may not choose jobs closely related to their majors and many job applicants are turned away despite their academic qualifications.
eight-e01.zh: 事实上，许多毕业生可能不会选择与专业密切相关的工作，而且不少求职者虽然拥有学历，仍遭到拒绝。

eight-e01.en: By contrast, those who do not go to college but receive vocational training may be better prepared for certain occupations than graduates of academic courses: such training provides them with hands-on, job-specific instruction and develops their technical competence, thus helping them become skilled plumbers, graphic designers, and cooks, among others.
eight-e01.zh: 相比之下，没有上大学而接受职业培训的人，在某些职业方面可能比学术课程的毕业生准备得更充分：这种培训为他们提供针对具体岗位的实践教学，培养技术能力，从而帮助他们成为熟练的管道工、平面设计师和厨师等。

eight-e01.en: Therefore, going to college may not be the optimal choice for high-school students whose interests and strengths lie in practical work.
eight-e01.zh: 因此，对于兴趣和长处在于实践性工作的高中生而言，上大学可能并非最佳选择。

eight-e01.en: I think all roads lead to Rome.
eight-e01.zh: 我认为条条大路通罗马。

eight-e01.en: University education is a common way for people to pursue happiness and success because it affords graduates access to more job opportunities, career progression, and a higher standard of living; however, vocational training can be a better means of achieving such goals for those seeking careers in skilled trades.
eight-e01.zh: 大学教育是人们追求幸福和成功的常见途径，因为它使毕业生能够获得更多就业机会、更好的职业发展和更高的生活水平；然而，对于希望进入技术工种的人来说，职业培训可能是实现这些目标的更好方式。

eight-e01.en: In addition, it is worthwhile to point out that a successful life should not be defined in terms of career development and financial security alone.
eight-e01.zh: 此外，值得指出的是，不应仅从职业发展和经济保障来定义成功的人生。

eight-e01.en: It should also encompass personal health and strong relationships with others; therefore, it is my opinion that university is not necessarily the best route for everyone, and that all-around and balanced development is important to a successful life.
eight-e01.zh: 成功的人生还应包括个人健康以及与他人的稳固关系；因此，我认为，大学并不一定是每个人的最佳道路，而全面、均衡的发展对于成功的人生十分重要。

eight-e02.en: Modern economies place a premium on educated workers and thus educational curricula are designed to equip students with the skills and knowledge they will need for higher education.
eight-e02.zh: 现代经济高度重视受过教育的劳动者，因此，课程设置旨在使学生具备接受高等教育所需的技能和知识。

eight-e02.en: However, with the urgent need for blue-collar workers comes a belief that students should be permitted to choose practical courses leading to careers such as carpentry in the later years of their school education.
eight-e02.zh: 然而，随着社会迫切需要蓝领工人，也出现了一种看法：应允许学生在学校教育的后期阶段，选择能够通向木工等职业的实用课程。

eight-e02.en: Although high school students can benefit from such specialized job training, a lower-secondary curriculum centred on general education should be compulsory for all.
eight-e02.zh: 尽管高中生可以从这种专业职业培训中受益，但以通识教育为中心的初中课程应是所有学生的必修内容。

eight-e02.en: The argument in favor of practical training is the alignment between the goal of education and the growing needs of the job market.
eight-e02.zh: 支持实践培训的理由是，教育目标与就业市场不断增长的需求相契合。

eight-e02.en: White-collar jobs are often preferred by the public, which can contribute to shortages in manual occupations (e.g., carpentry, cabinet making, plumbing).
eight-e02.zh: 公众往往更偏爱白领工作，这可能造成木工、家具制作和管道安装等体力技术职业的人手短缺。

eight-e02.en: It is understandable, therefore, that TVET (technical and vocational education and training) appeals to students, with vocational and trade schools preparing them for the job market by providing trade skills and trade theory, real-life examples, and hands-on experience, all of which can improve their prospects of finding work after graduation.
eight-e02.zh: 因此，技术与职业教育培训对学生有吸引力，是可以理解的；职业和技工学校通过提供行业技能与理论、真实案例以及实践经验，为学生进入就业市场作准备，而这些都可以改善他们毕业后的求职前景。

eight-e02.en: However, in my view, full-time vocational specialization should start only at high school, and a broad foundation in general education is important for development, be it personal or occupational.
eight-e02.zh: 然而，在我看来，全日制的职业专业化学习应仅从高中开始，而广泛的通识教育基础对个人和职业发展都十分重要。

eight-e02.en: In view of the fundamental purposes of education—to make individuals well-rounded citizens able to perform their duties; to develop their intellectual skills; and to prepare them to earn a living—what modern society needs is not just plumbers or carpenters who can do the job simply because of their specialized training from vocational school, but good plumbers or carpenters who can perform their tasks better precisely because they have a broad education as well as intensive specialized training.
eight-e02.zh: 考虑到教育的根本目的——使个人成为能够履行职责的全面公民、发展智力能力，并为谋生作准备——现代社会需要的不只是因为在职业学校接受了专业培训而能做这份工作的管道工或木工，而是优秀的管道工或木工：他们恰恰因为既接受了广泛教育，又接受了深入的专业培训，所以能够更好地完成工作。

eight-e02.en: Primary education alone is insufficient to provide this foundation, thus making the completion of lower-secondary general education necessary before full-time specialization.
eight-e02.zh: 仅有小学教育不足以奠定这一基础，因此，在全日制专业化学习之前，有必要完成初中阶段的通识教育。

eight-e02.en: In conclusion, emphasis can be put on practical training because of its function in training the workforce, but this sequence should be adopted: lower-secondary school students should follow a broad academic curriculum focused on general education, while high school students can exercise their freedom to choose their paths by acquiring either academic or technical qualifications.
eight-e02.zh: 总之，鉴于实践培训在培养劳动力方面的作用，可以重视实践培训，但应遵循这样的顺序：初中生应学习以通识教育为重点的广泛学术课程，而高中生则可以通过获得学术资格或技术资格，自由选择自己的道路。

eight-e03.en: There has been a fierce debate as to the organization of teaching.
eight-e03.zh: 关于如何组织教学，一直存在激烈争论。

eight-e03.en: Some suggest that one class should encompass students with mixed abilities, while others propose grouping more academically able students together and offering them special teaching.
eight-e03.zh: 有人建议一个班应容纳能力不同的学生，而另一些人主张把学业能力较强的学生编在一起，并为他们提供特殊教学。

eight-e03.en: Both views are discussed here to seek a conclusion.
eight-e03.zh: 本文将讨论双方观点，以得出结论。

eight-e03.en: The primary justification for mixed-ability classes has traditionally resided in the belief that children have the right to equal educational opportunities and can benefit from learning together.
eight-e03.zh: 传统上，支持混合能力班的主要理由在于这样一种信念：儿童有权享有平等的教育机会，并能从共同学习中受益。

eight-e03.en: As a school is a miniature society in which differences in individuals’ abilities are accepted, the same principle applies: every student, whether high-achieving or in need of additional support, should enjoy the same educational opportunities.
eight-e03.zh: 学校是一个接纳个体能力差异的微型社会，因此同样的原则也适用于学校：每名学生，无论成绩优异还是需要额外支持，都应享有同等的教育机会。

eight-e03.en: Moreover, a lower-achieving student who learns in a mixed-ability class may be less likely to feel inferior to others, as they are not separated from their peers on the basis of academic achievement, whereas their counterparts in the streaming system may feel stigmatized, which may undermine their confidence and self-esteem, thus having a detrimental effect on their long-term development.
eight-e03.zh: 此外，在混合能力班学习的学业表现较弱的学生，由于没有因学业表现而被单独分班，可能较少感到自卑；相比之下，分流制度下的同类学生可能感到自己被贴上负面标签，这可能削弱他们的信心和自尊，进而不利于其长期发展。

eight-e03.en: Others, however, highlight the benefits of grouping students by current academic ability.
eight-e03.zh: 然而，另一些人强调按学生当前学业能力分组的好处。

eight-e03.en: This method can respond thoughtfully and responsibly to differences in academic performance.
eight-e03.zh: 这种方法能够审慎而负责地回应学生学业表现上的差异。

eight-e03.en: In comparison with an unstreamed teaching mode, in which teachers have to adapt lessons to a wide range of learning needs, a streaming setting can further the educational achievement of students who assimilate new knowledge quickly while allowing teachers to help students who need more support to gain a better understanding of the material.
eight-e03.zh: 在不分流的教学模式中，教师必须调整课程以适应差异很大的学习需求；相比之下，分流教学既能促进吸收新知识较快的学生取得更高的学业成就，也能让教师帮助需要更多支持的学生更好地理解学习内容。

eight-e03.en: Streaming, therefore, can help students fulfil their potential.
eight-e03.zh: 因此，分流教学可以帮助学生充分发挥潜力。

eight-e03.en: I think this policy could be justified if special treatment means accelerating learning for more academically able students while ensuring equal access to resources and allowing movement between groups, thereby reducing the risk of inequality or discrimination; it can also preserve a learning environment with diversity, as there still are myriad ways in which students differ from one another (e.g., family background, religion, language, and gender).
eight-e03.zh: 我认为，如果特殊对待意味着让学业能力较强的学生加快学习，同时确保学生平等获得资源，并允许他们在不同组别之间流动，从而降低不平等或歧视的风险，那么这项政策就可能有其合理性；它也能保留多样化的学习环境，因为学生之间仍存在无数种差异，例如家庭背景、宗教、语言和性别。

eight-e03.en: In conclusion, in view of the advantages of grouping, it is sensible to adopt flexible streaming at schools, whereby teaching resources can be allocated efficiently, maximizing opportunities to deliver relatively more personalized education.
eight-e03.zh: 总之，考虑到分组的优势，学校采用灵活的分流教学是合理的，这样既能高效分配教学资源，也能尽可能提供相对更加个性化的教育。

eight-e04.en: There has been a fierce yet unresolved debate as to what a decent university education truly is.
eight-e04.zh: 关于真正优质的大学教育究竟应是什么样，一直存在激烈而尚无定论的争论。

eight-e04.en: Some educationalists propose that universities should place a premium on practical training while excluding theoretical knowledge.
eight-e04.zh: 一些教育家主张大学应高度重视实践培训，同时排除理论知识。

eight-e04.en: Even though practical training warrants attention, there is no justification for eliminating theoretical knowledge from higher education.
eight-e04.zh: 尽管实践培训值得重视，但没有理由将理论知识从高等教育中剔除。

eight-e04.en: The argument in favor of practical training is the alignment between the goal of education and the growing needs of job markets.
eight-e04.zh: 支持实践培训的理由是，教育目标与就业市场日益增长的需求相契合。

eight-e04.en: Job candidates who have just graduated from universities are often criticized as ill-prepared for employment, as they have little, if any, hands-on experience in solving problems in a real situation.
eight-e04.zh: 刚从大学毕业的求职者经常被批评没有为就业做好准备，因为他们几乎没有在真实情境中解决问题的实践经验。

eight-e04.en: As a result, considerable time and money may have to be channelled into employee training.
eight-e04.zh: 因此，企业可能不得不投入大量时间和资金培训员工。

eight-e04.en: If greater emphasis were placed on practical training, then the goal of education, whereby students acquire professional competence, could be better achieved while facilitating their adjustment to work, thus potentially increasing profits for companies.
eight-e04.zh: 如果更加重视实践培训，教育帮助学生获得职业胜任能力的目标就可能得到更好实现，同时学生也能更顺利地适应工作，从而可能增加企业利润。

eight-e04.en: However, a command of theoretical knowledge is an important foundation for better performance in many occupations and domains, as it enables students to understand clearly, to analyze critically, and thus to perform systematically.
eight-e04.zh: 然而，掌握理论知识是在许多职业和领域中取得更好表现的重要基础，因为它使学生能够清晰理解、批判分析，进而有条理地开展工作。

eight-e04.en: With mechanical theory, an engineer is better equipped not only to operate the machine already installed but also to cope with unforeseeable emergencies; with accounting theory, an accountant is better equipped not only to calculate taxes but also to help companies balance the budget; and with educational psychology, a secondary school teacher is better equipped not only to transmit knowledge but also to deal with adolescent problems associated with rebellious behaviour.
eight-e04.zh: 掌握机械理论的工程师不仅更有能力操作已经安装的机器，也更有能力应对难以预料的紧急情况；掌握会计理论的会计师不仅更有能力计算税款，也更有能力帮助企业平衡预算；掌握教育心理学的中学教师不仅更有能力传授知识，也更有能力处理与叛逆行为相关的青春期问题。

eight-e04.en: It is clear, therefore, that theoretical knowledge should be an indispensable aspect of higher education.
eight-e04.zh: 因此，显然理论知识应当是高等教育不可或缺的一部分。

eight-e04.en: In conclusion, students should receive training in theoretical knowledge and practical skills, both of which are indispensable in paving the way for future success.
eight-e04.zh: 总之，学生应同时接受理论知识和实践技能方面的培养，因为二者都是为未来成功铺路所不可或缺的。

eight-e05.en: The contribution made by university education to individuals and societies is clear.
eight-e05.zh: 大学教育对个人和社会的贡献是显而易见的。

eight-e05.en: However, fierce debate remains with regard to what the daily schedule of university students should encompass.
eight-e05.zh: 然而，关于大学生日常安排应包含哪些内容，激烈争论仍在持续。

eight-e05.en: Even though the acquisition of knowledge is fundamental, extracurricular activities are also essential to a balanced university education.
eight-e05.zh: 尽管知识的获取是基础，但课外活动对于均衡的大学教育也同样必不可少。

eight-e05.en: Central to university education is the acquisition of knowledge, which is easy to understand in view of professional competence.
eight-e05.zh: 获取知识是大学教育的核心，从职业胜任能力的角度看，这很容易理解。

eight-e05.en: With growing globalization comes occupational differentiation, leading to knowledge-intensive job markets.
eight-e05.zh: 全球化不断发展，带来了职业分工的细化，使就业市场日益以知识为密集要素。

eight-e05.en: Students whose academic performance improves through diligent study can enjoy more job opportunities, higher salaries, career progression, and thus a higher standard of living.
eight-e05.zh: 通过勤奋学习提高学业表现的学生，可以获得更多就业机会、更高薪水和职业晋升，进而享有更高的生活水平。

eight-e05.en: It is, therefore, sensible for students to devote substantial time to their studies.
eight-e05.zh: 因此，学生将大量时间投入学习是合理的。

eight-e05.en: However, a university education should encompass socialization, which is fostered through interaction with others.
eight-e05.zh: 然而，大学教育也应包括通过与他人互动而培养的社会化能力。

eight-e05.en: Extracurricular activities such as participation in university associations are great avenues for students to share and explore their interests with like-minded people.
eight-e05.zh: 参加大学社团等课外活动，是学生与志趣相投的人分享和探索兴趣的良好途径。

eight-e05.en: In doing so, students have chances to sharpen or acquire skills – interpersonal skills and communication skills necessary for their future social activities; organizational skills that can boost their careers; and practical skills that students cannot acquire simply by learning theoretical knowledge.
eight-e05.zh: 在这一过程中，学生有机会提升或获得多种技能：未来社会活动所必需的人际交往和沟通技能，有助于职业发展的组织技能，以及无法仅靠学习理论知识获得的实践技能。

eight-e05.en: Hence, it is essential to be involved in other activities such as those organized by student associations.
eight-e05.zh: 因此，参与学生社团组织的活动等其他活动至关重要。

eight-e05.en: In conclusion, the acquisition of knowledge is the cornerstone of personal success, while engaging in extracurricular activities is an important ingredient of personal socialization.
eight-e05.zh: 总之，获取知识是个人成功的基石，而参与课外活动则是个人社会化的重要组成部分。

eight-e05.en: Only when the pursuit of academic achievement is integrated with social learning through activities can university education fulfil both these aims.
eight-e05.zh: 只有将追求学业成就与通过活动开展社会学习结合起来，大学教育才能同时实现这两个目标。

eight-e06.en: The contribution made by general education to individuals and societies is clear.
eight-e06.zh: 通识教育对个人和社会的贡献是显而易见的。

eight-e06.en: However, with increasing occupational differentiation comes the belief that universities should concentrate on one particular subject so that students can specialize.
eight-e06.zh: 然而，职业分工日益细化，随之而来的是这样一种看法：大学应集中教授某一特定学科，让学生能够专门深入学习。

eight-e06.en: Even though some people advocate specialization, there are good reasons why a wide range of subjects should be offered at universities.
eight-e06.zh: 尽管有些人提倡专业化，但大学开设广泛的学科仍有充分理由。

eight-e06.en: The argument in favour of specialization is the focused use of effort and attention, which facilitates achieving more desirable results.
eight-e06.zh: 支持专业化的理由在于，它能让努力和注意力更加集中，从而有助于取得更理想的成果。

eight-e06.en: Rather than merely studying a wide range of subjects, students could concentrate more fully on one academic speciality, which can help them deliver better academic performance.
eight-e06.zh: 学生可以更充分地专注于某一学术专业，而不是仅仅广泛涉猎许多学科，这能帮助他们取得更好的学业表现。

eight-e06.en: This can contribute to scientific and technological advancement because specialists working at the frontiers of knowledge may be better equipped to make breakthroughs; this can also help students climb the career ladder because industrial society is increasingly knowledge-intensive.
eight-e06.zh: 这可以促进科技进步，因为在知识前沿工作的专家可能更有能力取得突破；这也能帮助学生逐步获得职业晋升，因为工业社会日益成为知识密集型社会。

eight-e06.en: It may seem sensible, therefore, for a university to concentrate its teaching on one subject.
eight-e06.zh: 因此，大学将教学集中于一个学科似乎是合理的。

eight-e06.en: However, the advantages of specialization do not mean that universities should exclude other subjects, since general learning can complement professional competence.
eight-e06.zh: 然而，专业化的优势并不意味着大学应排除其他学科，因为通识学习能够补充专业能力。

eight-e06.en: In effect, understanding the basic principles in a range of fields helps students understand better what they already know, and equips them to sharpen their skills and knowledge within one particular subject.
eight-e06.zh: 事实上，了解多个领域的基本原理，有助于学生更深入地理解已经掌握的内容，并使他们能够进一步提升某一特定学科内的技能和知识。

eight-e06.en: In terms of professional competence, well-rounded job candidates are truly educated human beings who can perform their special tasks better precisely because they have general education as well as intensive specialized training.
eight-e06.zh: 从职业胜任能力来看，全面发展的求职者才是真正受过教育的人；他们之所以能够更好地完成专业任务，恰恰是因为既接受过通识教育，也接受过深入的专业训练。

eight-e06.en: For example, an industrial designer and businessman who takes a calligraphy class may be able to use this broader learning to improve product design.
eight-e06.zh: 例如，一位兼具工业设计师和商人身份的人，如果上过书法课，就可能将这种更广泛的学习用于改善产品设计。

eight-e06.en: In conclusion, it is necessary to retain general education at university, while specialization should also be valued, both of which can help individuals to succeed in the future.
eight-e06.zh: 总之，大学有必要保留通识教育，同时也应重视专业化，因为二者都能帮助个人在未来取得成功。

nine-01.en: There has been a fierce yet unresolved debate as to how to deal with climate change.
nine-01.zh: 关于如何应对气候变化，一直存在激烈而尚无定论的争论。

nine-01.en: With the difficulty in tackling the changes to weather patterns on a global scale comes a belief that efforts should be made, not to prevent further warming, but to live with climate change.
nine-01.zh: 由于应对全球范围内天气模式的变化十分困难，一种看法随之产生：人们应努力适应气候变化，而不是阻止进一步变暖。

nine-01.en: Although efforts should be made to adapt to the current situation, the importance of prevention should not be diminished.
nine-01.zh: 虽然应努力适应当前状况，但不应削弱对预防重要性的重视。

nine-01.en: The argument in favour of coexisting with climate change is that such a problem cannot be resolved in a short time.
nine-01.zh: 支持与气候变化共存的理由是，这一问题无法在短时间内得到解决。

nine-01.en: There are many contributors to climate change, such as fossil-fuel consumption, industrial emissions, and population growth, among others, some of which are difficult to stop completely.
nine-01.zh: 造成气候变化的因素有很多，例如化石燃料消耗、工业排放和人口增长等，其中一些很难被完全阻止。

nine-01.en: As a result, a sensible way to alleviate its effects is to adapt to such a worrying situation.
nine-01.zh: 因此，减轻其影响的一种合理方式，就是适应这一令人担忧的局面。

nine-01.en: For example, residents and developers can heatproof buildings by planting large trees that offer shade and putting plants and gardens on top of roofs to help reduce heat entering buildings.
nine-01.zh: 例如，居民和开发商可以种植提供树荫的大树，并在屋顶种植植物和建造花园，以减少进入建筑的热量，从而提高建筑的隔热能力。

nine-01.en: Streets can also be covered with light-coloured materials that reflect rather than absorb sunlight, so they remain cooler than typical black roads.
nine-01.zh: 街道也可以铺设反射而非吸收阳光的浅色材料，使其比普通黑色路面更凉爽。

nine-01.en: Therefore, learning to live with this problem is viable and necessary.
nine-01.zh: 因此，学会与这一问题共存既可行又必要。

nine-01.en: However, reaching such a conclusion does not necessarily diminish the importance of prevention.
nine-01.zh: 然而，得出这一结论并不必然削弱预防的重要性。

nine-01.en: Growth in energy consumption can be restricted through greater efficiency in a way that supports economic development while slowing down the rate at which fossil fuels are being burned; meanwhile, efforts are being made to develop alternative energy sources (e.g., solar power and wind energy), which can reduce reliance on fossil fuels.
nine-01.zh: 提高能源效率可以在支持经济发展的同时限制能源消耗的增长，并减缓化石燃料的燃烧速度；与此同时，人们正努力开发太阳能和风能等替代能源，以减少对化石燃料的依赖。

nine-01.en: Completely halting climate change is impossible in a short time, but efforts to limit further warming should never be underestimated.
nine-01.zh: 短时间内完全阻止气候变化是不可能的，但限制进一步变暖的努力绝不应被低估。

nine-01.en: Such progress, however minimal it is, can ultimately help us to achieve our goal: preventing further damage from climate change.
nine-01.zh: 这样的进步无论多么微小，最终都能帮助我们实现目标：防止气候变化造成进一步破坏。

nine-01.en: In conclusion, although efforts should be made to adapt to the current situation, the achievement of sustainable development necessitates efforts to prevent further warming.
nine-01.zh: 总之，尽管应努力适应当前状况，但实现可持续发展也需要努力防止进一步变暖。

nine-01.en: Only with both adaptation and prevention can society truly benefit.
nine-01.zh: 只有同时采取适应与预防措施，社会才能真正受益。

nine-02.en: The killing and slaughter of animals for food, research and product testing have been sanctioned by long usage; however, with advances in modern society comes a belief that such behaviour should cease forthwith.
nine-02.zh: 为了食物、研究和产品测试而杀害或屠宰动物，长期以来因惯例而被认可；然而，随着现代社会的进步，一种看法随之出现，认为这种行为应立即停止。

nine-02.en: Even though animals have a prima facie right to life, some uses of animals remain necessary and can be morally justified, while certain practices are unacceptable.
nine-02.zh: 尽管动物原则上享有生存权，但某些动物利用方式仍有必要，并且在道德上可以得到辩护，而某些做法则不可接受。

nine-02.en: The argument against such exploitation for food is that animals deserve a prima facie right to life, which could be overridden by human survival needs in the past due to the scarcity of food resources.
nine-02.zh: 反对为食物而这样利用动物的理由是，动物理应享有原则性的生存权；过去由于食物资源匮乏，这一权利可能需要让位于人类的生存需求。

nine-02.en: Agriculture has thrived in recent years, making it possible for many people to rely on plant-based foods to acquire the necessary protein and other nutrients.
nine-02.zh: 近年来农业蓬勃发展，使许多人能够依靠植物性食物获得必需的蛋白质和其他营养素。

nine-02.en: However, it is not realistic to assume that all people can stop eating meat and rely solely on plant-based foods immediately, nor can we assume that the world population currently has access to nutritionally adequate alternatives.
nine-02.zh: 然而，认为所有人都能立即停止吃肉并完全依靠植物性食物，并不现实；我们也不能假定世界人口目前都能获得营养充分的替代食物。

nine-02.en: The same principles also apply to medical research.
nine-02.zh: 同样的原则也适用于医学研究。

nine-02.en: The use of animals in testing can be morally acceptable, given that developing and testing a vaccine for a lethal human disease may require animal studies where validated alternatives are unavailable.
nine-02.zh: 考虑到为致命的人类疾病研发和测试疫苗，在没有经过验证的替代方法时可能需要进行动物研究，因此使用动物进行试验在道德上可以是可接受的。

nine-02.en: In such cases, the practice can be morally justified, provided that these animals used in experimentation are humanely treated.
nine-02.zh: 在这种情况下，只要实验所用的动物得到人道对待，这种做法就在道德上具有合理性。

nine-02.en: However, when it comes to non-food products such as clothes, it is worthwhile to point out that alternatives to animals’ skins and hides, including man-made fibres such as rayon, already exist and can be produced on a large scale, thus making it unnecessary to kill animals solely for clothes.
nine-02.zh: 然而，谈到衣物等非食品产品时，值得指出的是，包括人造丝等人造纤维在内的动物皮革替代品已经存在，而且能够大规模生产，因此没有必要仅为制作衣物而杀害动物。

nine-02.en: However, the skins and hides that are produced by the meat-packing industry should be fully used.
nine-02.zh: 不过，肉类加工业所产生的动物皮革应得到充分利用。

nine-02.en: Nonetheless, some species are hunted and killed solely for their skins and furs, including lizards, foxes, and crocodiles, among others, which justifies a strict prohibition on such slaughter.
nine-02.zh: 尽管如此，某些物种仍仅因其皮或毛皮而遭到猎杀，包括蜥蜴、狐狸和鳄鱼等，因此严格禁止这类屠杀是有理由的。

nine-02.en: In conclusion, slaughtering animals to produce food and medicine can be justified where it remains necessary, while a total ban on hunting animals solely for their skins and furs to make clothes should be imposed.
nine-02.zh: 总之，在仍有必要的情况下，为生产食物和药物而屠宰动物可以有其合理性；而对于仅为获取皮革和毛皮制作衣物而猎杀动物的行为，则应实行全面禁令。

nine-03.en: The answer is unequivocal as to the importance of protecting animals; however, some people argue that undue emphasis is put on the safeguarding of various species of wild animals and birds.
nine-03.zh: 保护动物的重要性毋庸置疑；然而，一些人认为，对保护各种野生动物和鸟类的重视程度过高。

nine-03.en: Although such efforts may seem unnecessary, less effort has been made than is needed to prevent animals from dying out.
nine-03.zh: 虽然这些努力可能看起来没有必要，但为防止动物灭绝而付出的努力仍少于实际所需。

nine-03.en: The argument against current conservation initiatives is that they are an unnecessary waste of valuable resources.
nine-03.zh: 反对当前保护行动的理由是，它们无谓地浪费了宝贵资源。

nine-03.en: Critics argue that the natural development of ecosystems involves survival of the fittest, whereby better-adapted animals are more likely to survive while some species go extinct.
nine-03.zh: 批评者认为，生态系统的自然发展包含适者生存的过程，即适应能力较强的动物更有可能存活，而一些物种则会灭绝。

nine-03.en: They believe that this should not be interrupted by human intervention arising from the seeming kindness and care for certain animals.
nine-03.zh: 他们认为，不应因为对某些动物表面上的善意与关爱，就通过人为干预来打断这一过程。

nine-03.en: However, much of the current reduction in biodiversity is associated with human activities rather than natural processes alone.
nine-03.zh: 然而，目前生物多样性的减少，很大一部分与人类活动有关，而不只是自然过程所致。

nine-03.en: The populations of some species, such as cheetahs and snow leopards, have declined, putting them at risk of extinction.
nine-03.zh: 猎豹和雪豹等某些物种的数量已经下降，使它们面临灭绝风险。

nine-03.en: Such problems, in fact, strongly correlate with human activities such as commercial logging, urban sprawl, and poaching, among others, thus necessitating conservation efforts to reduce this damage.
nine-03.zh: 事实上，这些问题与商业伐木、城市蔓延和偷猎等人类活动密切相关，因此有必要采取保护措施来减少这种损害。

nine-03.en: Moreover, opponents of animal protection claim that with too much focus on such conservation comes an economic burden.
nine-03.zh: 此外，反对动物保护的人声称，过度关注这类保护会带来经济负担。

nine-03.en: Many endangered species are found in developing nations in Africa, Southeast Asia, and South America.
nine-03.zh: 许多濒危物种分布于非洲、东南亚和南美洲的发展中国家。

nine-03.en: National governments in these countries have a variety of other concerns related to healthcare, education, and employment, among others.
nine-03.zh: 这些国家的政府还面临医疗、教育和就业等各种其他问题。

nine-03.en: The money spent on animal conservation could otherwise be used to address these human needs.
nine-03.zh: 用于动物保护的资金，本来可以用来满足这些人类需求。

nine-03.en: However, the government budget can be allocated to address both conservation and human welfare, rather than treating them as mutually exclusive.
nine-03.zh: 然而，政府预算可以同时用于动物保护和人类福祉，而不必将二者视为相互排斥。

nine-03.en: If a relatively small conservation budget were to be used for other concerns, it might bring only limited improvements in other areas while failing to mitigate the problem of declining wildlife populations, a problem that can have far-reaching effects on humans through damage to ecosystems.
nine-03.zh: 如果将数额相对较小的保护预算转用于其他事务，可能只能给其他领域带来有限改善，却无法缓解野生动物数量下降的问题；这一问题会破坏生态系统，进而可能对人类产生深远影响。

nine-03.en: In conclusion, despite the financial cost, it is essential to protect wild animals which may go extinct.
nine-03.zh: 总之，尽管需要付出财政成本，保护可能灭绝的野生动物仍至关重要。

nine-03.en: More attention to animal protection is still needed; governments should continue to take action before it is too little, too late.
nine-03.zh: 动物保护仍需得到更多重视；政府应继续行动，以免为时过晚、力度不足。

nine-04.en: The answer is unequivocal as to the importance of protecting animals; however, some have suggested that the protection of wild animals should be selective, whereas others believe that all wild animals deserve attention.
nine-04.zh: 保护动物的重要性毋庸置疑；然而，有人建议对野生动物的保护应有所选择，而另一些人认为所有野生动物都值得关注。

nine-04.en: Both views are discussed here to seek a conclusion.
nine-04.zh: 本文将讨论双方观点，以得出结论。

nine-04.en: The argument in favour of safeguarding certain wild animals is that they should be distinguished from other species by the threats they face and their value.
nine-04.zh: 支持保护某些特定野生动物的理由是，应根据它们面临的威胁和自身价值，将它们与其他物种区别对待。

nine-04.en: For instance, unlike animals such as rats and pigeons, which have adapted successfully to urban environments, tigers are endangered wild animals and require intensive conservation efforts.
nine-04.zh: 例如，与已经成功适应城市环境的老鼠和鸽子等动物不同，老虎属于濒危野生动物，需要高强度的保护。

nine-04.en: Therefore, there is insufficient justification for providing equal support to species in different circumstances.
nine-04.zh: 因此，对处境不同的物种提供同等支持，并没有充分理由。

nine-04.en: Moreover, advocates of selective protection regard some animals as more deserving of preservation.
nine-04.zh: 此外，支持选择性保护的人认为，一些动物更值得保存。

nine-04.en: The tiger, to continue the previous example, is greatly valued for being elegant and for being rare, while animals such as bees are valuable not for their beauty but for their usefulness to humanity.
nine-04.zh: 继续以前面的老虎为例，它因优雅和稀有而受到高度重视；蜜蜂等动物则不是因美丽，而是因对人类有用而具有价值。

nine-04.en: However, the urgency of protecting a particular bee species may be lower if it has a large and stable population.
nine-04.zh: 然而，如果某种蜜蜂的数量庞大且稳定，保护它的紧迫性就可能较低。

nine-04.en: However, all wild animals deserve protection from human harm, as humanity has been a catalyst for the endangerment of many species.
nine-04.zh: 然而，所有野生动物都应受到保护，免遭人类伤害，因为人类活动促使许多物种陷入濒危境地。

nine-04.en: The populations of some species, including cheetahs, snow leopards and certain bee species, have declined, raising concerns about their survival.
nine-04.zh: 包括猎豹、雪豹和某些蜜蜂在内的一些物种数量已经下降，引发了对其生存的担忧。

nine-04.en: Such problems, in fact, strongly correlate with human activities such as commercial logging, urban sprawl, and poaching, among others, thus necessitating efforts to stop such destructive behaviour rather than simply protect some species for their perceived value.
nine-04.zh: 事实上，这些问题与商业伐木、城市蔓延和偷猎等人类活动密切相关，因此应努力制止这类破坏性行为，而不只是根据人们所认为的价值来保护某些物种。

nine-04.en: I think biodiversity is a sine qua non for the sustainable functioning of ecosystems because species are closely interconnected, thus challenging the idea that only certain animals deserve protection.
nine-04.zh: 我认为，生物多样性是生态系统持续运作不可或缺的条件，因为各物种紧密相连，这使“只有某些动物值得保护”的观点受到质疑。

nine-04.en: For example, the loss of bees in an area could cause problems for pollination and thus for herbivores that depend on affected plants, eventually disrupting the food chain and potentially affecting predators such as tigers.
nine-04.zh: 例如，某个地区蜜蜂的消失可能造成授粉问题，进而影响依赖相关植物的食草动物，最终扰乱食物链，并可能影响老虎等捕食者。

nine-04.en: Therefore, all animals deserve protection, albeit with differing levels of attention and resources: efforts (e.g., sanctuaries) to protect tigers are tangible, while bees may receive help through less obvious measures to preserve their habitats.
nine-04.zh: 因此，所有动物都值得保护，尽管关注程度和资源投入可以不同：保护老虎的措施，例如设立保护区，是看得见的，而蜜蜂可能通过较不显眼的栖息地保护措施获得帮助。

nine-04.en: In conclusion, humans should endeavour to protect as many animals as possible, although some species may be prioritized in terms of attention and resources according to the threats they face.
nine-04.zh: 总之，人类应努力保护尽可能多的动物，尽管可以根据各物种所面临的威胁，在关注程度和资源分配上优先照顾某些物种。

nine-05.en: One of the worrying trends in modern society is that the number of animals and plants is declining.
nine-05.zh: 现代社会中一个令人担忧的趋势是，动植物的数量正在减少。

nine-05.en: This occurs for several reasons, the foremost of which is destructive human activity.
nine-05.zh: 这一现象有多种原因，其中最主要的是具有破坏性的人类活动。

nine-05.en: Concerted efforts should be made by governments and individuals.
nine-05.zh: 政府和个人应共同努力。

nine-05.en: The underlying reason for this trend is human activity.
nine-05.zh: 这一趋势的根本原因是人类活动。

nine-05.en: Many forests are being threatened by deforestation for agricultural expansion, logging, and infrastructure development.
nine-05.zh: 许多森林正因农业扩张、伐木和基础设施建设所造成的砍伐而受到威胁。

nine-05.en: A typical example can be found in the Amazon rainforest, where pristine habitats are being cleared for cattle ranching, depriving countless species of their natural homes.
nine-05.zh: 亚马孙雨林就是一个典型例子，那里原始的栖息地正在被清理，用于养牛，导致无数物种失去天然家园。

nine-05.en: An additional human activity that deserves attention is the illegal wildlife trade.
nine-05.zh: 另一项值得关注的人类活动是非法野生动植物贸易。

nine-05.en: This practice is driven by high demand for exotic pets, traditional medicine, and animal parts, pushing many species, be they animals or plants, towards endangerment and potential extinction.
nine-05.zh: 对异宠、传统药物和动物身体部位的旺盛需求推动了这种行为，使许多物种，无论动物还是植物，都走向濒危，甚至可能灭绝。

nine-05.en: What steps can governments and individuals take to halt and reverse the trend?
nine-05.zh: 政府和个人可以采取哪些措施来遏止并扭转这一趋势呢？

nine-05.en: For governments, the keys to reversing environmental degradation are conservation and restoration efforts.
nine-05.zh: 对政府来说，扭转环境退化的关键在于保护与修复行动。

nine-05.en: For instance, reforestation initiatives can aim to replant native tree species in deforested areas, providing crucial habitats for various wildlife species.
nine-05.zh: 例如，重新造林项目可以致力于在遭到砍伐的地区补种本地树种，为各种野生动物提供关键栖息地。

nine-05.en: Individuals can also help by recognizing how their daily behaviour could lead to catastrophes for certain animals or plants and avoiding products that contribute to this damage.
nine-05.zh: 个人也可以提供帮助：认识到日常行为可能给某些动植物带来灾难，并避免购买助长这种损害的产品。

nine-05.en: For example, a figure delicately carved in ivory can mean that an elephant has been killed for commercial gain; a so-called magic medicine can involve uncontrolled exploitation of wild plants.
nine-05.zh: 例如，一件精雕细刻的象牙摆件可能意味着一头大象为商业利益而遭到杀害；一种所谓的神奇药物可能涉及对野生植物不受控制的采挖。

nine-05.en: When the buying stops, the killing can too.
nine-05.zh: 购买停止时，杀戮也可能随之停止。

nine-05.en: In conclusion, human activities have taken a heavy toll on flora and fauna; therefore, efforts, ranging from government policies to individuals refusing to buy illegally traded wildlife products, should be made to mitigate the problems.
nine-05.zh: 总之，人类活动已对动植物造成严重损害；因此，应采取从政府政策到个人拒绝购买非法交易的野生动植物产品等各种行动，以缓解这些问题。

nine-05.en: Otherwise, the continued reduction of biodiversity could be a recipe for disaster.
nine-05.zh: 否则，生物多样性的持续减少可能酿成灾难。

nine-06.en: One of the growing trends in modern society is that people increasingly choose to travel abroad.
nine-06.zh: 现代社会中一个日益明显的趋势是，越来越多的人选择出国旅行。

nine-06.en: This occurs for several reasons, foremost of which are higher per capita income and the development of the airline industry.
nine-06.zh: 这一现象有多种原因，其中最主要的是人均收入提高和航空业发展。

nine-06.en: Despite the potential adverse effects on the environment, this trend, on balance, produces positive outcomes when its risks are managed.
nine-06.zh: 尽管可能对环境产生不利影响，但当风险得到管理时，这一趋势总体上会带来积极结果。

nine-06.en: The primary reason lies in the fact that more people today can afford to travel internationally.
nine-06.zh: 主要原因在于，如今更多人负担得起国际旅行。

nine-06.en: As world trade thrives, the middle class is expanding, thus making it possible for more people to use disposable income to travel to other countries.
nine-06.zh: 随着世界贸易蓬勃发展，中产阶层不断壮大，使更多人能够用可支配收入到其他国家旅行。

nine-06.en: This boom is also attributed to the fact that companies like Boeing have produced more efficient planes, the fact that competition among airlines has intensified, and the fact that budget airlines have expanded, all of which combined have ushered in an era of international tourism.
nine-06.zh: 这股热潮也可归因于波音等企业生产了效率更高的飞机、航空公司之间的竞争加剧，以及廉价航空公司的扩张；这些因素共同开启了国际旅游的新时代。

nine-06.en: For example, Chinese tourists can take advantage of budget airlines to travel to countries such as Thailand.
nine-06.zh: 例如，中国游客可以利用廉价航空前往泰国等国家旅行。

nine-06.en: This boom brings cultural benefits to individuals and economic benefits to destinations.
nine-06.zh: 这股热潮为个人带来文化方面的益处，也为目的地带来经济收益。

nine-06.en: International travel exposes tourists to exotic cultures, ranging from what people usually eat to how people celebrate local festivals.
nine-06.zh: 国际旅行让游客接触异国文化，范围从人们平时吃什么，到人们如何庆祝当地节日。

nine-06.en: For example, tourists can eat sushi and enjoy the fireworks during summer in Japan.
nine-06.zh: 例如，游客可以在日本吃寿司，并在夏天欣赏烟火。

nine-06.en: In addition, international tourism contributes to greater economic prosperity.
nine-06.zh: 此外，国际旅游有助于促进经济繁荣。

nine-06.en: Wildlife viewing, for example, has become a source of income for African countries such as Tanzania; the Pyramids bring a large influx of tourists to Egypt, and their spending can help raise local incomes and improve living standards.
nine-06.zh: 例如，野生动物观赏已成为坦桑尼亚等非洲国家的收入来源；金字塔为埃及吸引了大量游客，他们的消费能帮助提高当地收入并改善生活水平。

nine-06.en: With this boom also come problems.
nine-06.zh: 这股热潮也伴随着问题。

nine-06.en: The environmental impacts are largely attributable to the development of the hospitality industry (e.g., hotels, restaurants, and shops) and infrastructure (e.g., roads and power supply).
nine-06.zh: 其环境影响在很大程度上可归因于酒店、餐馆和商店等接待服务业，以及道路和电力供应等基础设施的发展。

nine-06.en: This can give rise to higher levels of deforestation and construction, thus leading to damage to wildlife habitats and a decline in biodiversity.
nine-06.zh: 这可能导致更多森林砍伐和建设活动，进而破坏野生动物栖息地，并使生物多样性下降。

nine-06.en: However, such problems can be mitigated by concerted efforts from governments (e.g., regulations governing sustainable development) and individuals (e.g., environmentally responsible behaviour).
nine-06.zh: 然而，政府和个人共同努力可以缓解这些问题，例如政府制定管理可持续发展的规定，个人采取对环境负责的行为。

nine-06.en: For example, governments can restrict deforestation for tourist facilities and ban single-use plastic bags, while tourists can avoid touching coral reefs when diving.
nine-06.zh: 例如，政府可以限制为建设旅游设施而砍伐森林，并禁止使用一次性塑料袋；游客则可以在潜水时避免触碰珊瑚礁。

nine-06.en: In conclusion, increased income and low-cost air travel act as catalysts for international tourism.
nine-06.zh: 总之，收入增长和低成本航空旅行推动了国际旅游的发展。

nine-06.en: It can be a win-win situation for tourists and tourist destinations despite the possible environmental problems, provided that government policies and individual efforts keep such damage under control.
nine-06.zh: 尽管可能存在环境问题，但只要政府政策和个人努力能够控制这类损害，国际旅游就可以成为游客与旅游目的地双赢的局面。

nine-07.en: The market for international tourism has thrived in recent years; however, a fierce debate remains as to its overall effects on local inhabitants and the environment.
nine-07.zh: 近年来，国际旅游市场蓬勃发展；然而，关于它对当地居民和环境的总体影响，激烈争论仍未平息。

nine-07.en: On balance, it yields positive outcomes in the form of economic prosperity and cultural preservation, despite some potential environmental and cultural issues.
nine-07.zh: 尽管可能带来一些环境和文化问题，但总体权衡后，它仍能以经济繁荣和文化保护的形式带来积极结果。

nine-07.en: The tourism industry can be an effective way to create job opportunities and earn foreign exchange.
nine-07.zh: 旅游业可以有效创造就业机会并赚取外汇。

nine-07.en: Wildlife viewing, for example, has become a source of income for African countries such as Tanzania, and this revenue can contribute to higher per capita income, improved living standards and greater prosperity.
nine-07.zh: 例如，野生动物观赏已成为坦桑尼亚等非洲国家的收入来源，这类收入可以帮助提高人均收入、改善生活水平并促进繁荣。

nine-07.en: Therefore, it is people in developing economies who may have particular need of an influx of tourists, as participation in international tourism can bring valuable employment opportunities.
nine-07.zh: 因此，发展中经济体的民众可能尤其需要游客涌入，因为参与国际旅游能够带来宝贵的就业机会。

nine-07.en: However, it is argued that this boom could take its toll on the local environment and culture.
nine-07.zh: 然而，有人认为，这股热潮可能损害当地环境和文化。

nine-07.en: The environmental impacts are largely attributed to the development of the hospitality industry (e.g., hotels, restaurants, and shops) and infrastructure (e.g., roads and power supply).
nine-07.zh: 其环境影响在很大程度上被归因于酒店、餐馆和商店等接待服务业，以及道路和电力供应等基础设施的发展。

nine-07.en: This can give rise to higher levels of deforestation and construction, thus leading to damage to wildlife habitats and a decline in biodiversity.
nine-07.zh: 这可能导致更多森林砍伐和建设活动，进而破坏野生动物栖息地，并使生物多样性下降。

nine-07.en: However, such problems can be mitigated by concerted efforts from governments (e.g., regulations governing sustainable development) and individuals (e.g., environmentally responsible behaviour).
nine-07.zh: 然而，政府和个人共同努力可以缓解这些问题，例如政府制定管理可持续发展的规定，个人采取对环境负责的行为。

nine-07.en: For example, governments can restrict deforestation for tourist facilities and ban single-use plastic bags, while tourists can avoid touching coral reefs when diving.
nine-07.zh: 例如，政府可以限制为建设旅游设施而砍伐森林，并禁止使用一次性塑料袋；游客则可以在潜水时避免触碰珊瑚礁。

nine-07.en: Moreover, critics worry that when mass tourism enters a place, acculturation may occur (i.e., the modification of an existing culture through contact with other cultures).
nine-07.zh: 此外，批评者担心，大众旅游进入某地时，可能发生文化适应，即原有文化因接触其他文化而改变。

nine-07.en: It can lead to cultural homogenization and weaken local traditions, as local communities may commercialize the indigenous culture or disregard their traditional customs and values so that they can advertise their modernity to attract more tourists.
nine-07.zh: 这可能导致文化同质化，并削弱当地传统，因为当地社区可能将本土文化商业化，或忽视传统习俗和价值观，以宣传自身的现代化并吸引更多游客。

nine-07.en: However, with policies that place a premium on cultural histories, local heritage sites, and customs, the adverse effects on local culture can be mitigated and tourism itself can become a vehicle for preserving and revitalizing local cultures.
nine-07.zh: 然而，通过重视文化历史、当地遗产地和习俗的政策，可以减轻对当地文化的不利影响，而旅游本身也能成为保护和复兴地方文化的途径。

nine-07.en: Local communities, for instance, could operate tour businesses themselves, encouraging tourists to visit their villages and using the income to sustain local customs.
nine-07.zh: 例如，当地社区可以自行经营旅游业务，鼓励游客到村庄参观，并用所得收入维持当地习俗。

nine-07.en: This culture-based tourism can strengthen cultural identity and heighten a sense of belonging.
nine-07.zh: 这种以文化为基础的旅游可以增强文化认同，并提升归属感。

nine-07.en: In conclusion, even though stories abound as to how international tourism affects the local environment and culture, it is sensible to encourage global tourism that is safeguarded by regulation from governments and concerted efforts from local inhabitants and visitors.
nine-07.zh: 总之，尽管关于国际旅游如何影响当地环境和文化的事例很多，但鼓励受到政府监管，并由当地居民和游客共同努力加以保障的全球旅游，是合理的。

nine-07.en: Where these safeguards keep environmental and cultural damage limited, I believe that continuing gains in local livelihoods and cultural preservation outweigh those remaining harms.
nine-07.zh: 在这些保障措施能将环境和文化损害控制在有限范围内的情况下，我认为，当地生计和文化保护方面持续获得的收益，超过了仍然存在的那些损害。

nine-08.en: The resources from books, films, and the Internet have grown significantly in cultural importance.
nine-08.zh: 来自书籍、电影和互联网的资源，在文化方面的重要性已显著提高。

nine-08.en: With this comes a belief that long gone are the days when people had to travel to other places to learn about local culture.
nine-08.zh: 随之而来的是这样一种看法：人们必须亲赴他处才能了解当地文化的时代，早已过去。

nine-08.en: Despite the advantages accruing from these resources, they cannot fully replace tourism in view of its value as a direct cultural experience and the personal nature of travel.
nine-08.zh: 尽管这些资源带来了好处，但考虑到旅游作为直接文化体验的价值，以及旅行所具有的个人性质，它们无法完全取代旅游。

nine-08.en: The primary justification for such an idea resides in the belief that some of the educational functions of tourism can be fulfilled by other media.
nine-08.zh: 支持这一观点的主要理由在于，人们认为旅游的部分教育功能能够由其他媒介实现。

nine-08.en: Traditionally, people spend significant resources on transportation and accommodation, be it time or money; however, books, films, and the Internet can provide us with information about many cultures from anywhere in the world and save the money and time that would otherwise be spent on tourism.
nine-08.zh: 传统上，人们在交通和住宿上投入大量资源，无论时间还是金钱；然而，书籍、电影和互联网能让我们从世界任何地方获得有关多种文化的信息，并节省原本会用于旅游的金钱和时间。

nine-08.en: Travel enthusiasts, for example, can just look through the information in the comfort of their own homes with their computers or tablets.
nine-08.zh: 例如，旅行爱好者只需在舒适的家中，用电脑或平板浏览相关信息。

nine-08.en: It seems, therefore, sensible to agree with the opinion in question to some extent.
nine-08.zh: 因此，在一定程度上同意这一观点似乎是合理的。

nine-08.en: However, this does not necessarily mean that such resources can replace the firsthand learning that tourism provides.
nine-08.zh: 然而，这并不必然意味着这些资源能取代旅游所带来的亲身学习。

nine-08.en: It brings cultural benefits to individuals and economic benefits to destinations.
nine-08.zh: 旅游为个人带来文化益处，也为目的地带来经济收益。

nine-08.en: It exposes tourists to exotic cultures, ranging from what people usually eat to how people celebrate local festivals.
nine-08.zh: 它让游客接触异国文化，范围从人们平时吃什么，到人们如何庆祝当地节日。

nine-08.en: For example, tourists can eat sushi and enjoy the fireworks during summer in Japan with local people, gaining direct experiences of local customs that descriptions alone cannot fully reproduce.
nine-08.zh: 例如，游客可以在日本与当地人一起吃寿司，在夏天欣赏烟火，直接体验当地习俗，而这些体验无法仅靠描述得到完整再现。

nine-08.en: In addition, a separate benefit of tourism is its contribution to greater economic prosperity.
nine-08.zh: 此外，旅游另一项独立的好处，是有助于促进经济繁荣。

nine-08.en: Wildlife viewing, for example, has become a source of income for African countries such as Tanzania; the Pyramids bring a large influx of tourists to Egypt, and their spending can help raise local incomes and improve living standards.
nine-08.zh: 例如，野生动物观赏已成为坦桑尼亚等非洲国家的收入来源；金字塔为埃及吸引了大量游客，他们的消费能帮助提高当地收入并改善生活水平。

nine-08.en: Moreover, tourism, however it is defined, offers a unique individual experience, distinct from the experiences conveyed by writers, bloggers, or filmmakers.
nine-08.zh: 此外，无论如何定义旅游，它都能提供独特的个人体验，不同于作家、博主或电影制作者所传达的体验。

nine-08.en: This experience involves the preparation for the trip (e.g., reading a travel book to find useful information to make travel plans); unforgettable events (e.g., getting lost in big cities or missing the train); and an understanding of the discrepancy between the plan and the reality (e.g., the food does not taste as good as the writer says).
nine-08.zh: 这种体验包括行前准备，例如阅读旅行书籍以查找制定行程所需的信息；令人难忘的事件，例如在大城市迷路或错过火车；以及对计划与现实之间差距的认识，例如食物并不像作者说的那么好吃。

nine-08.en: Such experiences, be they bitter or pleasant, ultimately become personal memories, abiding and precious.
nine-08.zh: 这些体验无论苦涩还是愉快，最终都会成为长久而珍贵的个人记忆。

nine-08.en: Therefore, books and the Internet, as ways to communicate travel information and share travel experiences, cannot fully reproduce such a personal experience.
nine-08.zh: 因此，书籍和互联网虽然能够传递旅行信息、分享旅行经历，却无法完整再现这种个人体验。

nine-08.en: In conclusion, people can learn from books, films or the Internet about other places, which should be regarded as a way to explore the world; however, travel enables them to experience local culture directly and deepen their understanding of local people.
nine-08.zh: 总之，人们可以通过书籍、电影或互联网了解其他地方，这应当被视为探索世界的一种方式；然而，旅行使他们能够直接体验当地文化，并加深对当地人的理解。

nine-08.en: It can also benefit the destinations economically.
nine-08.zh: 旅行也能使目的地在经济上受益。

nine-09.en: Video games have thrived for many years; however, a fierce debate rages as to their overall effect on people.
nine-09.zh: 电子游戏多年来蓬勃发展；然而，关于它们对人们的总体影响，激烈争论持续不断。

nine-09.en: Some people worry about the mental and physical health problems that can ensue from addiction to games, whereas others regard them as educational tools and mass entertainment.
nine-09.zh: 有些人担心游戏成瘾可能引发心理和身体健康问题，而另一些人则将它们视为教育工具和大众娱乐。

nine-09.en: On balance, I think their advantages outweigh their disadvantages.
nine-09.zh: 总体权衡后，我认为它们利大于弊。

nine-09.en: One demerit of video games is that excessive or inappropriate use can take a heavy toll on young users mentally and physically.
nine-09.zh: 电子游戏的一个缺点是，过度或不当使用可能严重损害年轻玩家的身心健康。

nine-09.en: Some young users are susceptible to violent content in games, which may lead them to regard violence as an appropriate and natural way to cope with interpersonal conflicts, especially when the situation is sufficiently similar.
nine-09.zh: 一些年轻玩家容易受到游戏中暴力内容的影响，可能因此将暴力视为应对人际冲突的一种恰当而自然的方式，尤其是在现实情境与游戏情境足够相似的时候。

nine-09.en: In addition, when users fail to detach themselves from games, physical problems may arise: they have fewer opportunities to participate in outdoor activities, thus becoming more accustomed to a sedentary lifestyle.
nine-09.zh: 此外，当玩家无法从游戏中抽身时，身体问题可能随之出现：他们参与户外活动的机会减少，从而更加习惯久坐的生活方式。

nine-09.en: Prolonged inactivity may contribute to obesity, while excessive gaming may also interfere with their concentration on other tasks.
nine-09.zh: 长期缺乏活动可能促成肥胖，而过度游戏也可能妨碍他们专心处理其他任务。

nine-09.en: However, recognising such risks does not necessarily diminish their value.
nine-09.zh: 然而，认识到这些风险并不必然削弱游戏的价值。

nine-09.en: They can be harmless fun when played in moderation, because physical problems and a sedentary lifestyle are more closely linked to excessive use than to playing games per se.
nine-09.zh: 适度游戏可以成为无害的娱乐，因为身体问题和久坐生活方式与过度使用的关系，比与玩游戏这件事本身的关系更为密切。

nine-09.en: People can play computer games in moderation just to switch off from the pressures of real life.
nine-09.zh: 人们可以适度玩电脑游戏，只是为了暂时摆脱现实生活的压力。

nine-09.en: In addition, gamers, when operating gaming controls, can develop good hand-eye coordination and sharpen skills like decision-making, anticipation, and resource management.
nine-09.zh: 此外，玩家操作游戏控制器时，可以培养良好的手眼协调能力，并提升决策、预判和资源管理等技能。

nine-09.en: For example, when users play a game set in a historical period, they may be taken on a trip down historical memory lane, as the game can introduce them to historical events and figures, although fictional elements need to be distinguished from historical facts.
nine-09.zh: 例如，当玩家玩一款以某个历史时期为背景的游戏时，游戏可能带他们回顾历史，因为游戏能介绍历史事件和人物，不过需要区分虚构元素与历史事实。

nine-09.en: In conclusion, video games on balance afford people valuable opportunities to learn and have fun, while many of their risks can be reduced by choosing suitable content and limiting playing time.
nine-09.zh: 总之，总体而言，电子游戏为人们提供了宝贵的学习和娱乐机会，而通过选择合适内容并限制游戏时间，其许多风险都能降低。

nine-09.en: I therefore consider their advantages greater than their disadvantages, provided that governments and individuals make concerted efforts through appropriate regulation and self-discipline.
nine-09.zh: 因此，只要政府和个人通过适当监管与自律共同努力，我就认为它们的优点大于缺点。

nine-10.en: One of the growing trends in modern society is that a large proportion of adults now enjoy playing mobile games during their free time.
nine-10.zh: 现代社会中一个日益明显的趋势是，如今很大一部分成年人喜欢在闲暇时玩手机游戏。

nine-10.en: This occurs for several reasons, foremost of which is their ready accessibility.
nine-10.zh: 这一现象有多种原因，其中最主要的是手机游戏随手可玩的便利性。

nine-10.en: Despite its entertainment value, this trend on balance produces negative outcomes because gaming can be addictive and time-wasting.
nine-10.zh: 尽管具有娱乐价值，但总体而言，这一趋势会产生负面结果，因为游戏可能使人成瘾并浪费时间。

nine-10.en: The primary cause of such popularity of mobile games is their availability.
nine-10.zh: 手机游戏如此受欢迎的主要原因，是它们容易获取。

nine-10.en: In the past, many digital games were played on desktop computers or consoles; however, games are now accessible on smartphones, therefore making it possible for people to play anywhere whenever they want, such as on the commute to work.
nine-10.zh: 过去，许多电子游戏需要在台式电脑或游戏机上玩；而如今，人们可以通过智能手机玩游戏，因此能够随时随地游玩，例如在上班通勤途中。

nine-10.en: In addition, compared with recreational activities such as fishing or mountain climbing, which can require considerable money and time, mobile games can be one of the cheapest and easiest ways to switch off from the pressures of real life, to pass the time while waiting for other activities, and to connect with other players socially.
nine-10.zh: 此外，与可能需要大量时间和金钱的钓鱼、登山等休闲活动相比，手机游戏可能是最便宜、最轻松的方式之一，既能暂时摆脱现实生活的压力，也能在等待其他活动时消磨时间，还能与其他玩家进行社交联系。

nine-10.en: However, the entertainment value of such behaviour pales in comparison to its potential impact on health and time management when gaming becomes excessive.
nine-10.zh: 然而，当游戏变得过度时，相比于它对健康和时间管理的潜在影响，这种行为的娱乐价值就显得逊色。

nine-10.en: Some mobile games involve repetitive tasks and frequent rewards that can keep users occupied and entertained for hours, which may be detrimental to their mental and physical health if gaming displaces sleep and exercise.
nine-10.zh: 一些手机游戏包含重复性任务和频繁奖励，能让玩家连续数小时投入其中、获得娱乐；如果游戏挤占了睡眠和锻炼时间，就可能不利于身心健康。

nine-10.en: In addition, gaming companies can use daily rewards to encourage people to log into a game every day, which means that excessive amounts of time may be spent on it, time that could otherwise be spent with family members or used to pursue other hobbies.
nine-10.zh: 此外，游戏公司可以用每日奖励鼓励人们每天登录游戏，这意味着人们可能在游戏上花费过多时间，而这些时间本可以用于陪伴家人或发展其他爱好。

nine-10.en: The cumulative effect could be to make individuals less active and leave them with fewer opportunities for creative pursuits.
nine-10.zh: 累积效应可能使个人更加缺乏活动，并减少他们从事创造性活动的机会。

nine-10.en: In conclusion, adults play mobile games more often these days because of the availability of mobile technology and the opportunities for inexpensive entertainment, and I regard this trend as harmful when habitual gaming displaces more active or productive uses of time.
nine-10.zh: 总之，由于移动技术普及，以及能够获得低成本娱乐，如今成年人更频繁地玩手机游戏；当习惯性游戏挤占了本可用于更积极或更有成效活动的时间时，我认为这一趋势是有害的。

nine-10.en: This pattern should be changed: adults should play in moderation and recognise that some of their time could be better used.
nine-10.zh: 这一模式应当改变：成年人应适度游戏，并认识到自己的一部分时间可以得到更好的利用。

nine-11.en: Movies and computer games are growing in popularity; however, opinions differ as to those containing violence.
nine-11.zh: 电影和电脑游戏越来越受欢迎；然而，对于其中含有暴力内容的作品，人们意见不一。

nine-11.en: Some feel that such violence contributes to problems in society and that these movies and games should thus be censored, whereas others believe they are harmless relaxation.
nine-11.zh: 有些人认为，这类暴力内容助长了社会问题，因此应对这些电影和游戏进行审查；而另一些人认为，它们只是无害的放松方式。

nine-11.en: Both views are discussed here to seek a conclusion.
nine-11.zh: 本文将讨论双方观点，以得出结论。

nine-11.en: The argument against such movies and computer games is that they may take a heavy toll on young users mentally.
nine-11.zh: 反对这类电影和电脑游戏的理由是，它们可能严重损害年轻使用者的心理健康。

nine-11.en: Some young users may have difficulty distinguishing between the virtual world and reality, making them susceptible to violent content in games, which may lead them to regard violence as an appropriate and natural way to cope with interpersonal conflicts, especially when the situation is sufficiently similar.
nine-11.zh: 一些年轻使用者可能难以区分虚拟世界与现实，使他们容易受到游戏中暴力内容的影响，并可能将暴力视为应对人际冲突的一种恰当而自然的方式，尤其是在现实情境与游戏情境足够相似的时候。

nine-11.en: For example, a young viewer might imitate threatening behaviour shown in a movie when faced with a conflict, potentially worsening the conflict.
nine-11.zh: 例如，年轻观众面对冲突时，可能模仿电影中展示的威胁行为，从而有可能使冲突恶化。

nine-11.en: Others, however, highlight the fact that many individuals have no difficulty distinguishing between fiction and reality.
nine-11.zh: 然而，另一些人强调，许多人能够毫不困难地区分虚构与现实。

nine-11.en: Rather than necessarily being attracted to violence per se, consumers of violent entertainment may simply be passing the time or experiencing a vicarious thrill.
nine-11.zh: 暴力娱乐的消费者未必被暴力本身吸引，他们可能只是在消磨时间，或通过间接体验获得刺激。

nine-11.en: Their enjoyment of fictional violence does not in itself establish a willingness to commit violence in real life.
nine-11.zh: 喜欢虚构暴力，本身并不能证明他们愿意在现实生活中实施暴力。

nine-11.en: Moreover, problems in society may also relate to employment, economic conditions, discrimination, income inequality, and various systemic barriers; attributing them to violent entertainment therefore requires more than a similarity between fictional and real behaviour.
nine-11.zh: 此外，社会问题也可能与就业、经济状况、歧视、收入不平等和各种制度性障碍有关；因此，要将这些问题归因于暴力娱乐，不能仅凭虚构行为与真实行为之间的相似性。

nine-11.en: I think that depictions of violence can deepen people's understanding of it.
nine-11.zh: 我认为，对暴力的描绘能够加深人们对暴力的理解。

nine-11.en: By watching entertainment that portrays the consequences of violence, some people may be dissuaded from such behaviour because they gain a better understanding of what violence is in reality and what harm it can result in.
nine-11.zh: 观看呈现暴力后果的娱乐作品，可能使一些人放弃这种行为，因为他们能更清楚地理解现实中的暴力究竟是什么，以及它会造成什么伤害。

nine-11.en: Meanwhile, depictions of violence that are perceived as meaningful and thought-provoking can foster empathy with victims, admiration for acts of courage and moral beauty in the face of violence, or self-reflection about violent impulses.
nine-11.zh: 与此同时，那些被认为有意义、能引发思考的暴力描绘，能够使人同情受害者，赞赏面对暴力时展现的勇气和道德之美，或反思自身的暴力冲动。

nine-11.en: In conclusion, although violent content may pose risks for some viewers, much of it ought to be permitted in games and movies because it can provide relaxation and serve an educational purpose.
nine-11.zh: 总之，尽管暴力内容可能对部分观众构成风险，但游戏和电影中的许多这类内容仍应获准存在，因为它们可以提供放松，并发挥教育作用。

nine-11.en: A balanced approach would allow such content while governments impose appropriate restrictions on extremely violent scenes and protect younger audiences.
nine-11.zh: 均衡的做法应是允许此类内容存在，同时由政府对极端暴力场景施加适当限制，并保护年幼观众。

nine-12.en: There has been a fierce yet unresolved debate as to what roles males and females should play in society.
nine-12.zh: 关于男性和女性在社会中应扮演什么角色，一直存在激烈而尚无定论的争论。

nine-12.en: With perceived differences in physical ability comes the belief that women are ill-equipped to work in the police force or the army, whereas others insist that women can be as capable as their male counterparts in such professions.
nine-12.zh: 由于人们认为男女在体能上存在差异，一种观点随之出现，认为女性不具备在警察或军队中工作的充分条件；而另一些人坚持认为，在这些职业中，女性可以与男性同样胜任。

nine-12.en: Both views are discussed here to seek a conclusion.
nine-12.zh: 本文将讨论双方观点，以得出结论。

nine-12.en: The argument against women serving in the military or law enforcement agencies rests on concerns that some duties may be too physically demanding for them to qualify.
nine-12.zh: 反对女性在军队或执法机构服役的观点，源于这样一种担忧：某些职责对体力的要求可能过高，使她们难以达到任职标准。

nine-12.en: Unlike many less physically demanding jobs, being a soldier or a sworn officer can require applicants to be tough and strong physically and mentally, standards that critics believe some female candidates may struggle to meet.
nine-12.zh: 与许多体力要求较低的工作不同，军人或宣誓任职的警员可能需要申请人在身心上都坚强有力；批评者认为，部分女性申请者可能难以达到这些标准。

nine-12.en: These traits enable applicants to pass physical fitness assessments, endure rotating shift work, and help protect their safety when they are confronted with criminals or hostile forces.
nine-12.zh: 这些特质能使申请者通过体能考核、承受轮班工作，并帮助他们在面对罪犯或敌对武装时保障自身安全。

nine-12.en: Therefore, applicants who do not meet the relevant standards, regardless of gender, are not suitable for these particular duties; this does not establish that women as a group are unsuitable.
nine-12.zh: 因此，无论性别如何，未达到相关标准的申请者都不适合承担这些特定职责；但这并不能证明女性作为一个群体都不适合。

nine-12.en: Others, however, highlight the important role that females can play in the police force.
nine-12.zh: 然而，另一些人强调女性能在警察队伍中发挥的重要作用。

nine-12.en: Day-to-day policing includes community-oriented work, and in an institution designed to serve communities, many tasks rely on judgement and communication as well as physical fitness, so women can function and perform as well as men do, for example in conducting interviews, patrol activities, and traffic investigations.
nine-12.zh: 日常警务包括面向社区的工作，而在以服务社区为宗旨的机构中，许多任务除了体能，还依赖判断力和沟通能力，因此女性也能像男性一样发挥作用并完成工作，例如开展访谈、巡逻和交通调查。

nine-12.en: In view of the importance of being approachable, sympathetic, and communicative, female officers who possess these qualities can greatly contribute to the relationship between police departments and communities.
nine-12.zh: 考虑到平易近人、富有同情心和善于沟通的重要性，具备这些特质的女警能够大大促进警察部门与社区之间的关系。

nine-12.en: With regard to the military, soldiers do not always get involved in armed conflicts or have to undertake combat duties.
nine-12.zh: 至于军队，军人并非总是参与武装冲突或必须承担作战任务。

nine-12.en: Even though disparities in average physical strength exist, the gender gap in performing some military duties may be narrowed by the development of weapons and equipment.
nine-12.zh: 尽管平均体力存在差异，但武器装备的发展可能缩小男女在执行某些军事任务方面的差距。

nine-12.en: The success of a war or a battle rests not only on stamina and physical fitness but also on tactics and strategies.
nine-12.zh: 一场战争或战斗的胜利，不仅取决于耐力和体能，也取决于战术和战略。

nine-12.en: Such requirements justify the role of females, be they in the army, navy or air force, as gender alone does not determine an individual's intellectual ability.
nine-12.zh: 这些要求使女性在陆军、海军或空军中发挥作用具有合理性，因为性别本身并不能决定个人的智力。

nine-12.en: In conclusion, even though gender differences may exist in terms of average physical strength, females can play, and already play, a central role in policing and the armed forces, given the range of responsibilities in these occupations and the individual abilities they require.
nine-12.zh: 总之，尽管男女在平均体力方面可能存在差异，但考虑到警务和军队职责的多样性，以及这些职责所要求的个人能力，女性能够、并且已经在这些领域发挥核心作用。

nine-13.en: In many families, the traditional division in which the husband was the provider and the wife was the homemaker is changing; nowadays, both can be providers and active parents.
nine-13.zh: 在许多家庭中，丈夫负责养家、妻子料理家务的传统分工正在改变；如今，双方都可以承担经济供养责任，并积极参与育儿。

nine-13.en: This occurs for several reasons: discrimination against women in many workplaces has lessened and the definition of success for men has changed.
nine-13.zh: 这一现象有多种原因：许多工作场所对女性的歧视有所减轻，而男性成功的定义也已经改变。

nine-13.en: This on balance is a positive change.
nine-13.zh: 总体而言，这是一个积极的变化。

nine-13.en: One factor is that discrimination against women has been reduced in parts of university education and the labour market, which can lead to higher incomes for women.
nine-13.zh: 一个因素是，在部分大学教育和劳动力市场中，对女性的歧视有所减少，这可能使女性获得更高收入。

nine-13.en: Rather than being channelled into gender-stereotyped occupations such as education, human resources, and financial management, more women are now able to embrace opportunities to study academic specialities that lead to higher-paid occupations, such as engineering, which has traditionally been male-dominated.
nine-13.zh: 如今，更多女性不再被引导进入教育、人力资源和财务管理等带有性别刻板印象的职业，而是能够把握机会，学习通向高薪职业的专业，例如传统上由男性主导的工程学。

nine-13.en: This financially enables more women to be breadwinners; when a mother has stronger earning prospects than her partner, it can make financial sense for the father to stay at home.
nine-13.zh: 这使更多女性在经济上具备养家能力；当母亲的收入前景比伴侣更好时，由父亲留在家中照顾孩子，在经济上可能是合理的。

nine-13.en: The change in evaluation criteria for men’s success is also seen as an important explanation.
nine-13.zh: 衡量男性成功的标准发生变化，也被视为一个重要解释。

nine-13.en: Traditionally, people regarded career achievement and material success as the criteria of masculinity, and males were assumed to be less family-oriented, unskilled in parenting, and impatient with their children.
nine-13.zh: 传统上，人们将事业成就和物质上的成功视为男子气概的衡量标准，并认为男性较少以家庭为重、不擅长育儿，而且对孩子缺乏耐心。

nine-13.en: However, with changing social attitudes comes greater respect for their choices, attitudes and preferences.
nine-13.zh: 然而，社会观念的变化使人们更加尊重男性的选择、态度和偏好。

nine-13.en: No longer should fathers be worried about being criticised or feel embarrassed if they stay at home to look after their children; instead, they can feel comfortable and confident about what they do, and may even receive a compliment from neighbours on their good parenting.
nine-13.zh: 父亲如果留在家中照顾孩子，不应再担心受到批评或感到难堪；相反，他们可以对自己的行为感到自在而自信，甚至可能因育儿有方而得到邻居的称赞。

nine-13.en: This trend is, on balance, an indicator of progress towards gender equality and empowerment, as greater freedom of choice over paid work and childcare is given to both males and females.
nine-13.zh: 总体而言，这一趋势标志着性别平等与赋权的进步，因为男性和女性在有偿工作与照顾孩子之间，都获得了更大的选择自由。

nine-14.en: There has been a fierce yet unresolved debate as to how to improve gender equality.
nine-14.zh: 关于如何改善性别平等，一直存在激烈而尚无定论的争论。

nine-14.en: Some people propose introducing equal quotas for every subject at universities.
nine-14.zh: 一些人主张在大学每个专业中设置男女相等的招生配额。

nine-14.en: Even though this proposal can seemingly be regarded as a manifestation of improved gender equality, it can be counterproductive and is unnecessary as a blanket requirement.
nine-14.zh: 尽管这一提议表面上可以被视为性别平等改善的体现，但它可能适得其反，也没有必要成为一项一刀切的要求。

nine-14.en: There seems to be a gender stereotype in higher education, whereby female students are often channelled into subjects associated with gender-stereotyped occupations, such as education, human resources, and financial management.
nine-14.zh: 高等教育中似乎存在性别刻板印象，女生经常被引导进入与性别刻板化职业相关的学科，例如教育、人力资源和财务管理。

nine-14.en: If this proposal for equal numbers were to be adopted, then academic specialities that otherwise would be dominated by male students, such as engineering, could admit more female students, thus appearing to embody improved gender equality.
nine-14.zh: 如果采纳这项男女等额的提议，那么工程学等原本可能由男生占主导的专业，就能招收更多女生，从而看起来体现了性别平等的改善。

nine-14.en: However, a rigid equal-number policy can restrict students’ freedom of choice.
nine-14.zh: 然而，僵化的男女等额政策可能限制学生的选择自由。

nine-14.en: When qualified girls who want to study education are denied places merely to achieve a quota, problems arise: universities are in fact restricting their opportunity to select their own path of development.
nine-14.zh: 当想学教育学且符合条件的女生，仅为满足配额而被拒之门外时，问题便产生了：大学实际上限制了她们选择自身发展道路的机会。

nine-14.en: In the meantime, boys who plan to study engineering may also suffer, as some may be denied places in their preferred subject and end up studying other subjects such as nursing.
nine-14.zh: 与此同时，计划学习工程学的男生也可能受到影响，因为其中一些人可能无法进入心仪的专业，最终转而学习护理等其他学科。

nine-14.en: Students, therefore, should be given freedom with regard to what subjects they would like to study, with applications judged on relevant academic criteria.
nine-14.zh: 因此，应让学生自由选择自己想学的专业，并按相关学业标准评估其申请。

nine-14.en: Moreover, this proposal ignores the fact that males and females, although equal in their fundamental human rights in education, are different as individuals, differing in their choices, attitudes, and preferences.
nine-14.zh: 此外，这一提议忽视了一个事实：男女虽然在受教育的基本人权上平等，但作为个体，他们各不相同，在选择、态度和偏好上也存在差异。

nine-14.en: In effect, alongside discrimination in certain domains, preferences for future working conditions and duties may make some women less likely to choose male-dominated professions and therefore the related subjects; the same applies to some men considering female-dominated subjects.
nine-14.zh: 事实上，除了某些领域存在歧视外，对于未来工作条件和职责的偏好，也可能使部分女性较少选择男性主导的职业及相关专业；部分男性考虑女性主导的专业时，也同样如此。

nine-14.en: Hence, a disparity in the number of male and female students in a subject is not in itself evidence of unequal opportunity.
nine-14.zh: 因此，一个专业中男女学生人数不等，本身并不能证明机会不平等。

nine-14.en: In conclusion, it is unrealistic and unnecessary to require the same number of male and female students in all subjects.
nine-14.zh: 总之，要求所有学科中的男女学生人数相同，既不现实，也没有必要。

nine-14.en: Universities should protect students’ freedom of choice while removing discriminatory barriers, rather than assuming that every numerical difference requires a quota.
nine-14.zh: 大学应在消除歧视性障碍的同时，保护学生的选择自由，而不是假定每一项人数差异都需要通过配额来解决。

nine-15.en: Efforts have always been made to improve gender equality from generation to generation; some workplaces are adopting a policy whereby equal numbers of men and women should be employed.
nine-15.zh: 一代又一代人始终在努力改善性别平等；一些工作场所正在采用一项政策，要求雇用相同数量的男性和女性。

nine-15.en: Although it seemingly manifests improved gender equality, it can be used as a cover for continuing inequality, which makes reliance on numerical equality a negative development in my view.
nine-15.zh: 尽管这似乎体现了性别平等的改善，但它也可能成为持续存在的不平等的掩护，因此在我看来，依赖人数上的平等是一种负面发展。

nine-15.en: The argument in favour of this equal-number policy is that it can help tackle gender inequality in employment.
nine-15.zh: 支持这项男女等额政策的理由是，它有助于解决就业中的性别不平等。

nine-15.en: A gender stereotype in the workplace exists, whereby female employees are sometimes perceived as less capable and less assertive than their male counterparts; therefore, some employers tend to place a premium on male candidates.
nine-15.zh: 职场中存在性别刻板印象，女性员工有时被认为不如男性同事能干、果断；因此，一些雇主倾向于更加重视男性求职者。

nine-15.en: However, with this policy, female candidates can get more job opportunities than before.
nine-15.zh: 然而，通过这项政策，女性求职者可以比以往获得更多工作机会。

nine-15.en: For example, occupations such as engineering, surgery, and dentistry could attract more female recruits where men have traditionally predominated, which could improve women’s access to these professions.
nine-15.zh: 例如，在传统上男性占多数的工程、外科和牙科等职业中，这项政策可能吸引更多女性入职，从而改善女性进入这些职业的机会。

nine-15.en: However, numerical equality alone is insufficient and can be counterproductive if it diverts attention from other barriers.
nine-15.zh: 然而，单靠人数平等并不足够，如果它转移了人们对其他障碍的关注，还可能适得其反。

nine-15.en: The aim of gender equality in the workplace is to achieve broadly equal opportunities and outcomes for women and men, not necessarily outcomes that are exactly the same for all.
nine-15.zh: 职场性别平等的目标，是让男女大体上获得平等的机会和结果，而不一定要求所有人的结果完全一样。

nine-15.en: Female and male employees can differ in number when equal pay is offered for work of equal or comparable value; when the barriers to the full and equal participation of women in the workforce are removed; when access is provided to all occupations and industries, including leadership roles, regardless of gender; and when discrimination based on gender is eliminated, particularly discrimination related to family and caring responsibilities.
nine-15.zh: 即便女性和男性员工人数不同，仍可以做到：对相同或价值相当的工作支付同等报酬；消除女性充分、平等参与劳动的障碍；不论性别，都能进入所有职业和行业，包括担任领导职务；以及消除性别歧视，尤其是与家庭和照护责任有关的歧视。

nine-15.en: Therefore, an equal-number policy is far from enough, and some companies may adopt it while pretending that they have already done their best to achieve gender equality.
nine-15.zh: 因此，男女等额政策远远不够，而一些企业可能采取这一政策，却佯称自己已经为实现性别平等尽了最大努力。

nine-15.en: If this discourages further action, less visible inequalities in pay and promotion may persist.
nine-15.zh: 如果这妨碍了进一步行动，薪酬和晋升中不那么显眼的不平等就可能持续存在。

nine-15.en: In conclusion, although this equal-number policy can afford more job opportunities for women, treating it as sufficient ignores what gender equality means in the workplace.
nine-15.zh: 总之，尽管这项男女等额政策能够为女性提供更多工作机会，但把它视为已经足够，就忽视了职场性别平等的真正含义。

nine-15.en: More efforts are needed to truly reduce and remove inequality rather than letting it persist behind a policy of equal numbers.
nine-15.zh: 要真正减少并消除不平等，还需要付出更多努力，而不是让不平等继续隐藏在人数相等的政策背后。

nine-16.en: The significance of music is unquestionable; as a language that differs from what we speak every day, it is sometimes regarded as a universal means of human communication.
nine-16.zh: 音乐的重要性毋庸置疑；作为一种不同于日常口语的语言，它有时被视为人类通用的交流方式。

nine-16.en: Although music does have the power to communicate feelings to listeners, it is not a fully universal means of communicating specific meanings, in view of listeners’ diverse interpretations.
nine-16.zh: 尽管音乐确实具有向听众传递情感的力量，但考虑到听众的理解各不相同，它并不是传达具体含义的完全通用手段。

nine-16.en: The primary justification for the belief in music as a universal language resides in the fact that individuals can appreciate music without a language barrier.
nine-16.zh: 认为音乐是一种通用语言的主要理由在于，人们能够不受语言障碍影响地欣赏音乐。

nine-16.en: Listening to music seems like a one-sided conversation, during which listeners perceive common elements of communication, such as feelings and emotions, without analysing the meaning of every word and sentence.
nine-16.zh: 听音乐仿佛是一场单向对话，在这一过程中，听众无需分析每个词句的含义，就能感受到情感和情绪等交流中的共同要素。

nine-16.en: Listeners from different backgrounds, age groups or nationalities may sense peacefulness when listening to a gentle melody and feel relaxed and happy when listening to a lively song.
nine-16.zh: 不同背景、年龄或国籍的听众，在听到柔和旋律时，可能感到平静，在听到欢快歌曲时，则可能感到放松和愉悦。

nine-16.en: Therefore, certain melodies may resonate emotionally with people across cultures, which helps explain why music is described as universal.
nine-16.zh: 因此，某些旋律可能在不同文化的人群中引发情感共鸣，这有助于解释为什么音乐被称为通用语言。

nine-16.en: However, does this mean that music is a worldwide language?
nine-16.zh: 然而，这是否意味着音乐是一种世界通用的语言呢？
恐怕并非在所有意义上都是如此。

nine-16.en: One important function of language is to convey information accurately to avoid misunderstandings and ambiguity, although verbal language can also be ambiguous.
nine-16.zh: 语言的一个重要功能是准确传递信息，以避免误解和歧义，尽管言语本身也可能含糊不清。

nine-16.en: Music may be less suited to conveying precise information when listeners have different educational and life experiences; for example, a teenager might appreciate the literal meaning of a song’s lyrics while a listener familiar with its historical background might recognise a reference to a social movement.
nine-16.zh: 当听众的教育和生活经历不同时，音乐可能不太适合传递精确信息；例如，青少年可能只欣赏一首歌歌词的字面含义，而熟悉其历史背景的听众则可能识别出其中对某场社会运动的指涉。

nine-16.en: Such metaphors can be hard to interpret.
nine-16.zh: 这样的隐喻可能难以理解。

nine-16.en: Music can also be ambiguous because listeners unfamiliar with Chinese opera may have no idea how to interpret its conventions, just as those unfamiliar with a Western musical tradition may miss the cultural associations of its melodies.
nine-16.zh: 音乐也可能产生歧义，因为不熟悉中国戏曲的听众可能完全不知道如何理解其惯例，就像不熟悉某种西方音乐传统的人，可能无法领会其旋律所包含的文化联想一样。

nine-16.en: Therefore, music can be regarded as a language, a language that can convey some common emotions, but not one that reliably allows people to exchange precise ideas without a shared context.
nine-16.zh: 因此，音乐可以被视为一种语言，一种能够传达某些共同情绪的语言，但在缺乏共同语境时，它无法可靠地帮助人们交换精确的思想。

nine-16.en: In conclusion, although music achieves a kind of emotional communication that goes beyond spoken language, potentially connecting people all over the world, it does not provide a universally shared system for conveying precise meanings.
nine-16.zh: 总之，尽管音乐实现了一种超越口语的情感交流，可能将世界各地的人联系起来，但它并没有为传达精确含义提供一个普遍共享的体系。

nine-17.en: The significance of music throughout history is clear; however, opinions differ as to the main purpose of listening to music.
nine-17.zh: 音乐在历史上的重要性是显而易见的；然而，关于听音乐的主要目的，人们意见不一。

nine-17.en: Many believe that music serves primarily as a means of relaxation.
nine-17.zh: 许多人认为，音乐主要是一种放松方式。

nine-17.en: Although music serves other purposes, I regard relaxation as its most important function in everyday life.
nine-17.zh: 虽然音乐还有其他用途，但我认为放松是它在日常生活中最重要的功能。

nine-17.en: The argument in favour of the relaxation-centred idea is that music can be an escape from the routine drudgery of life.
nine-17.zh: 支持以放松为中心这一观点的理由是，音乐能让人暂时摆脱日常生活的单调劳苦。

nine-17.en: Examples abound as to how people relax by listening to music.
nine-17.zh: 人们通过听音乐放松的例子不胜枚举。

nine-17.en: Workers may listen to music on the commute to work so that they are less distracted by the noise on the subway; students may listen to music after doing homework to take their minds off the problems they are facing; parents may play music in the background when doing chores at home.
nine-17.zh: 上班族可能在通勤途中听音乐，以减少地铁噪声的干扰；学生可能在做完作业后听音乐，以暂时不去想自己面临的问题；父母可能在家中做家务时播放背景音乐。

nine-17.en: However, other purposes also deserve consideration.
nine-17.zh: 然而，其他用途也值得考虑。

nine-17.en: In difficult emotional periods, including after a bad breakup or the loss of a loved one, some individuals turn to music to lift their spirits.
nine-17.zh: 在情绪艰难的时期，包括经历痛苦分手或失去亲人之后，一些人会借助音乐振作精神。

nine-17.en: They may listen to sad music, which can not only trigger pain and sadness but also bring comfort and enjoyment.
nine-17.zh: 他们可能听悲伤的音乐，这不仅会引发痛苦和悲伤，也能带来安慰与愉悦。

nine-17.en: Moreover, music serves multiple purposes that include aiding memory, inspiring others, and fostering culture.
nine-17.zh: 此外，音乐具有多种用途，包括辅助记忆、鼓舞他人和培育文化。

nine-17.en: Educational songs can help impart knowledge; the national anthem can encourage people and inspire citizens; lyrics can be regarded as cultural products.
nine-17.zh: 教育歌曲可以帮助传授知识；国歌可以激励人们、鼓舞公民；歌词可以被视为文化产品。

nine-17.en: However, judged by their contribution to everyday well-being, these functions need not outweigh relaxation: relief from routine pressures can benefit people repeatedly across work, study and home life, while some educational and ceremonial uses serve narrower purposes on particular occasions.
nine-17.zh: 然而，如果根据对日常福祉的贡献来评判，这些功能未必超过放松：缓解日常压力能够在工作、学习和家庭生活中反复使人受益，而某些教育和仪式用途只在特定场合服务于较狭窄的目的。

nine-17.en: In conclusion, relaxation is music’s most important everyday function in my view, though this takes different forms depending on the person in question.
nine-17.zh: 总之，在我看来，放松是音乐在日常生活中最重要的功能，尽管具体形式因人而异。

nine-17.en: This desire to relax is part of a shared humanity that unites all people.
nine-17.zh: 这种放松的愿望，是所有人共有的人性的一部分，将人们联系在一起。

nine-18.en: Opinions differ as to how the government budget should be allocated.
nine-18.zh: 关于政府预算应如何分配，人们意见不一。

nine-18.en: Some people argue the government should pay for health care and education, whereas others believe that individuals should assume such responsibility.
nine-18.zh: 有些人认为政府应支付医疗和教育费用，而另一些人认为个人应承担这种责任。

nine-18.en: Both views are discussed here to seek a conclusion.
nine-18.zh: 本文将讨论双方观点，以得出结论。

nine-18.en: The argument in favour of requiring efforts from governments is that they should and can shoulder such responsibilities.
nine-18.zh: 支持要求政府付出努力的理由是，政府既应当、也有能力承担这些责任。

nine-18.en: Everyone has a stake in education and health care: society benefits from a well-educated workforce and people can suffer less when health care is available.
nine-18.zh: 教育和医疗关系到每一个人的切身利益：社会能从受过良好教育的劳动力中受益，而当医疗服务可获得时，人们能少受一些痛苦。

nine-18.en: Therefore, governments, as the protectors and organizers of society aiming to achieve future prosperity, should provide funding to support the development of health care and education.
nine-18.zh: 因此，政府作为社会的保护者和组织者，以实现未来繁荣为目标，应提供资金支持医疗和教育的发展。

nine-18.en: Moreover, governments have the capacity to do so because they collect taxes, so they should use this money to benefit the public in a different way; for example, government-funded schools and hospitals are built to better serve people’s needs.
nine-18.zh: 此外，政府具备这样做的能力，因为政府征收税款，所以应以不同方式用这些资金造福公众；例如，政府出资建设学校和医院，就是为了更好地满足人们的需求。

nine-18.en: Others, however, highlight that it is individuals who should pay for what they directly benefit from.
nine-18.zh: 然而，另一些人强调，个人应为自己直接受益的服务支付费用。

nine-18.en: When paying taxes, individuals are investing their money in social programs that they can benefit from; for example, governments channel the money into public transport projects such as the construction of the metro, from which the wider community can benefit.
nine-18.zh: 个人纳税时，是在把自己的钱投入可从中受益的社会项目；例如，政府将资金投入地铁建设等公共交通项目，更广泛的社区都能从中获益。

nine-18.en: By contrast, they view health care and education as more personal; from this perspective, it seems unfair to use money from all to pay for services that some people use much more than others.
nine-18.zh: 相比之下，他们认为医疗和教育更具个人性质；从这个角度看，用所有人的钱支付某些人使用得远比其他人频繁的服务，似乎不公平。

nine-18.en: In addition, public education and health care aim to give everyone equal access to educational resources and medical services.
nine-18.zh: 此外，公共教育和医疗旨在让每个人都能平等获得教育资源和医疗服务。

nine-18.en: Problems may arise if public provision excludes paid alternatives, since those willing to pay extra money for additional services may be unable to do so.
nine-18.zh: 如果公共服务排除了付费选择，就可能产生问题，因为那些愿意为额外服务多付钱的人，可能无法这样做。

nine-18.en: This also applies to education: extra efforts are made by parents, but their children may have no access to better educational resources, advanced learning facilities, and a lower student-teacher ratio.
nine-18.zh: 这一点同样适用于教育：即便父母付出额外努力，他们的孩子也可能无法获得更好的教育资源、更先进的学习设施，以及更低的生师比。

nine-18.en: In view of this, opponents argue that governments should not pay for education and health care, leaving their provision to the market.
nine-18.zh: 鉴于此，反对者认为政府不应支付教育和医疗费用，而应将这些服务的供给交给市场。

nine-18.en: I think it is better to seek a compromise between the two sides rather than take either position to extremes.
nine-18.zh: 我认为，最好在双方之间寻求折中，而不是将任何一方的立场推向极端。

nine-18.en: Governments should pay for health care and education, as they both lay a solid foundation for the sustainable development of nations; nonetheless, while governments should spare no effort to make sure every citizen has equal access to basic services by subsidizing schools and hospitals, they should also allow those who wish to pay for additional services to do so, and this is why private hospitals and schools exist in the real world.
nine-18.zh: 政府应支付医疗和教育费用，因为二者都为国家的可持续发展奠定坚实基础；不过，政府在补贴学校和医院、竭尽全力确保每位公民平等获得基本服务的同时，也应允许愿意为额外服务付费的人这样做，这也是现实中私立医院和学校存在的原因。

nine-18.en: Governments strive for all and individuals strive for themselves.
nine-18.zh: 政府为所有人努力，个人则为自己努力。

nine-19.en: There has been a fierce yet unresolved debate as to how to assist low-income students to access higher education.
nine-19.zh: 关于如何帮助低收入学生获得高等教育机会，一直存在激烈而尚无定论的争论。

nine-19.en: Some people propose introducing a policy whereby these students can be supported by government budgets.
nine-19.zh: 一些人建议推出一项政策，通过政府预算资助这些学生。

nine-19.en: Even though the government should shoulder some responsibility, paying their tuition fees in full may be impractical where budgets are limited, and thus a compromise is necessary.
nine-19.zh: 尽管政府应承担一定责任，但在预算有限时，全额支付他们的学费可能并不切实际，因此有必要采取折中方案。

nine-19.en: The primary justification for requiring financial support from governments resides in the belief that they should and can mitigate the problem.
