nine-19.zh: 要求政府提供经济支持的主要理由在于，人们认为政府应当并且能够缓解这一问题。

nine-19.en: Central to any nation is a well-educated workforce; thus, as the organizer of a nation, the government should take responsibility for supporting those students from poor families so that they can better contribute to society as a whole (e.g., by becoming medical experts, engineers, and lawyers).
nine-19.zh: 受过良好教育的劳动力是任何国家的核心；因此，政府作为国家的组织者，应负责支持来自贫困家庭的学生，使他们能够更好地为整个社会作出贡献，例如成为医学专家、工程师和律师。

nine-19.en: In addition, every year, governments collect money from taxpayers and allocate part of their budgets to higher education, which means it could be financially viable for governments to support those students.
nine-19.zh: 此外，政府每年向纳税人征税，并将一部分预算分配给高等教育，这意味着政府在财政上可能有能力支持这些学生。

nine-19.en: These duties and resources, therefore, support a role for government in educational assistance.
nine-19.zh: 因此，这些职责和资源支持政府在教育援助中发挥作用。

nine-19.en: However, reaching such a conclusion does not mean it is financially viable for governments to cover all tuition fees.
nine-19.zh: 然而，得出这一结论并不意味着政府在财政上有能力承担全部学费。

nine-19.en: Often, a large education budget has already been allocated to free primary education, which can enable individuals to acquire basic skills and knowledge, laying the groundwork for many to secure employment after graduating from middle or high school.
nine-19.zh: 通常，大量教育预算已经分配给免费初等教育，这能使个人获得基本技能和知识，为许多人在初中或高中毕业后找到工作奠定基础。

nine-19.en: This kind of support may be a priority in developing and underprivileged areas.
nine-19.zh: 在发展中地区和贫困地区，这类支持可能应当优先考虑。

nine-19.en: However, fully supporting economically deprived college students may seem to require little, but in fact may cost more than governments can afford.
nine-19.zh: 然而，全额资助经济困难的大学生看似所需不多，实际上却可能超出政府的负担能力。

nine-19.en: This suggests a compromise whereby the government does not provide full grants but can offer loans to assist these students in pursuing their education.
nine-19.zh: 这表明可以采取折中方案：政府不提供全额助学金，而是提供贷款，帮助这些学生继续求学。

nine-19.en: For example, a government could make such loans available to help low-income families, and students could repay them after graduation, a potentially beneficial arrangement in which students can continue their education and some public funding can later be recovered, although loans still involve public costs.
nine-19.zh: 例如，政府可以提供此类贷款帮助低收入家庭，学生则在毕业后偿还；这可能是一种有益安排，让学生能够继续接受教育，同时使部分公共资金日后得到回收，尽管贷款仍会产生公共成本。

nine-19.en: In conclusion, although governments should support students, paying their tuition fees in full may be impractical where budgets are limited.
nine-19.zh: 总之，尽管政府应支持学生，但在预算有限时，全额支付他们的学费可能并不切实际。

nine-19.en: A compromise should be reached between students from poor families and the government: further education could be made more accessible through interest-free student loans, provided the associated public costs are manageable.
nine-19.zh: 贫困家庭的学生与政府之间应达成折中：只要相关公共成本可控，就可以通过无息学生贷款，让更多人有机会继续接受教育。

nine-20.en: One of the worrying trends in modern society is that children have been increasingly suffering from obesity.
nine-20.zh: 现代社会中一个令人担忧的趋势是，越来越多的儿童受到肥胖问题困扰。

nine-20.en: It is believed by some people that the government should take responsibility for tackling this alarming situation.
nine-20.zh: 一些人认为，政府应负责应对这一令人警觉的局面。

nine-20.en: I agree that the government should do so, although success ultimately rests on concerted efforts by governments and parents.
nine-20.zh: 我同意政府应当这样做，尽管最终能否成功，取决于政府和父母的共同努力。

nine-20.en: The primary justification for requiring efforts from governments lies in the belief that they should and can help solve such problems.
nine-20.zh: 要求政府付出努力的主要理由在于，人们认为政府应当、也能够帮助解决这些问题。

nine-20.en: Central to the future well-being of any society is the healthy development of children; thus, as the protector of the citizenry and an institution aiming at sustainable development, the government should take responsibility for tackling the global obesity epidemic.
nine-20.zh: 儿童的健康成长关系到任何社会未来的福祉；因此，政府作为公民的保护者和以可持续发展为目标的机构，应承担应对全球肥胖流行问题的责任。

nine-20.en: In addition, governments can introduce and enforce laws; for example, they can place a ban on advertising to children for food and drinks high in sugar, salt, or fat, since such advertising may encourage unhealthy eating habits and contribute to childhood obesity.
nine-20.zh: 此外，政府可以制定并执行法律；例如，可以禁止面向儿童宣传高糖、高盐或高脂肪食品和饮料的广告，因为此类广告可能鼓励不健康的饮食习惯，并促成儿童肥胖。

nine-20.en: Stringent regulations could be imposed to mitigate the problem.
nine-20.zh: 可以通过实行严格规定来缓解这一问题。

nine-20.en: Therefore, these duties and powers support a role for government in addressing this issue.
nine-20.zh: 因此，这些职责和权力支持政府在处理这一问题时发挥作用。

nine-20.en: However, this worrying trend can hardly be halted or reversed by governments alone.
nine-20.zh: 然而，仅靠政府几乎无法遏止或扭转这一令人担忧的趋势。

nine-20.en: At a macro level, the government can help mitigate the problems that ensue from an unbalanced diet by restricting fast-food advertising to children.
nine-20.zh: 在宏观层面，政府可以通过限制面向儿童的快餐广告，帮助缓解饮食不均衡引发的问题。

nine-20.en: At a micro level, governments, unfortunately, often have limited influence over children’s sedentary habits at home.
nine-20.zh: 在微观层面，遗憾的是，政府对儿童在家中的久坐习惯往往影响有限。

nine-20.en: Children are prone to spend time watching television, playing video games, or using a mobile phone, all of which can occupy time that could otherwise be spent on exercise.
nine-20.zh: 儿童容易花时间看电视、玩电子游戏或使用手机，而这些活动都会占用本可用于锻炼的时间。

nine-20.en: This makes it difficult for governments to remedy the situation on their own, thus necessitating the role of parents, with whose guidance children can understand the adverse effects that ensue from obesity and move away from unhealthy lifestyle choices.
nine-20.zh: 这使政府难以独自改善局面，因此父母的作用不可或缺；在父母引导下，儿童能够了解肥胖带来的不利影响，并远离不健康的生活方式。

nine-20.en: In conclusion, governments have a responsibility to alleviate childhood obesity, but concerted efforts should be made by governments and parents, as both play indispensable roles in creating an environment conducive to children’s development.
nine-20.zh: 总之，政府有责任缓解儿童肥胖，但政府和父母应共同努力，因为二者在创造有利于儿童发展的环境方面，都发挥着不可或缺的作用。

nine-21.en: Opinions differ as to the topic of children’s education.
nine-21.zh: 人们对儿童教育这一话题持有不同看法。

nine-21.en: Some people believe that they should develop a sense of competition to become good members of society; however, others claim that emphasis should be placed on how to cooperate with others.
nine-21.zh: 有些人认为，孩子应培养竞争意识，才能成为社会的良好成员；另一些人则主张，应重视如何与他人合作。

nine-21.en: Both views are discussed here to seek a conclusion.
nine-21.zh: 下文将讨论这两种观点，以得出结论。

nine-21.en: The argument in favour of competition is that it acts as a catalyst for personal progress.
nine-21.zh: 支持竞争的理由是，它能够促进个人进步。

nine-21.en: With a sense of competition, children can understand one feature of modern society: in competitive situations, students who have performed better are often given priority over others who have not, which can motivate them to strive for excellence.
nine-21.zh: 有了竞争意识，孩子就能理解现代社会的一项特点：在竞争情境中，表现更好的学生往往比表现较差的学生获得优先机会，这可以激励他们追求卓越。

nine-21.en: For example, students make efforts to excel academically to gain admission to famous universities.
nine-21.zh: 例如，学生努力在学业上出类拔萃，以获得名牌大学的录取。

nine-21.en: This is also true when they grow up.

Those who learn to respond to competition can perform better when facing challenges rather than staying in their comfort zones, which may allow them to enjoy greater job opportunities, achieve better career progression, and thus play a more useful role in modern society.
nine-21.zh: 学会应对竞争的人在面对挑战时，能够争取更好的表现，而不是停留在舒适区；这可能让他们获得更多就业机会、取得更好的职业发展，从而在现代社会中发挥更有益的作用。

nine-21.en: Others, however, highlight the importance of cooperation.
nine-21.zh: 然而，另一些人强调合作的重要性。

nine-21.en: Many problems are too complex to be solved by individuals alone, thus necessitating the concerted efforts of a team.
nine-21.zh: 许多问题过于复杂，单凭个人无法解决，因此需要团队共同努力。

nine-21.en: For example, the success of a company ultimately rests on the efforts of its departments, including the production department, advertising department, and marketing department, among others.
nine-21.zh: 例如，一家公司的成功最终取决于生产、广告、营销等各部门的努力。

nine-21.en: But such cooperation between departments or within a department depends on members knowing how to share ideas with others, how to reach a compromise when ideas differ, and how to seek an optimum solution together.
nine-21.zh: 不过，部门之间或部门内部的这种合作，有赖于成员懂得如何与他人分享想法、如何在意见不一致时达成妥协，以及如何共同寻找最佳解决方案。

nine-21.en: In view of this, collaboration skills should be cultivated during childhood, so children can be well equipped for their future lives.
nine-21.zh: 因此，应从童年时期培养合作能力，让孩子为未来的生活做好充分准备。

nine-21.en: It is better to seek a compromise between the two sides rather than take either position to extremes.
nine-21.zh: 与其将任何一方的立场推向极端，不如寻求两者之间的折中。

nine-21.en: Without competition, some children may feel less motivated, making it harder for them to achieve their goals; without cooperation, individuals may find it difficult to go further, considering the limitations on personal abilities.
nine-21.zh: 没有竞争，一些孩子可能缺乏动力，从而更难实现目标；没有合作，考虑到个人能力的局限，人们可能很难走得更远。

nine-21.en: By integrating the two, we can encourage higher personal and team achievement.
nine-21.zh: 将两者结合起来，可以鼓励个人和团队取得更高的成就。

nine-22.en: Urgent problems abound in modern society; for example, global warming has caused changes in weather patterns on a global scale.
nine-22.zh: 现代社会充满紧迫问题；例如，全球变暖已经使全球范围内的天气模式发生变化。

nine-22.en: With this comes the belief that most urgent issues can only be mitigated by international cooperation.
nine-22.zh: 由此产生了一种看法，即大多数紧迫问题只能通过国际合作得到缓解。

nine-22.en: Although many global problems necessitate international cooperation, I only partly agree with this view, since some urgent regional problems can be addressed by local governments acting independently.
nine-22.zh: 尽管许多全球性问题需要国际合作，我只部分同意这一观点，因为一些紧迫的地区性问题可以由地方政府独立解决。

nine-22.en: The primary justification for requiring international cooperation is that countries should and can work together to mitigate such problems.
nine-22.zh: 要求开展国际合作的主要理由是，各国应该、也能够携手缓解这些问题。

nine-22.en: So interconnected is the world that no country can evade responsibility for mitigating shared global problems to which it contributes, albeit to varying degrees.
nine-22.zh: 世界的联系如此紧密，以至于没有哪个国家能够逃避缓解共同全球问题的责任，因为各国都在不同程度上促成了这些问题。

nine-22.en: For example, all humans are facing the problem of global warming, the causes of which include industrial emissions, deforestation, and emissions from air travel, among others; therefore, global cooperation should be pursued.
nine-22.zh: 例如，全人类都面临全球变暖问题，其成因包括工业排放、森林砍伐和航空出行排放等，因此应推动全球合作。

nine-22.en: Moreover, efforts must be coordinated on a global scale for these measures to be effective.
nine-22.zh: 此外，要使这些措施奏效，各方必须在全球范围内协调行动。

nine-22.en: High-income countries such as the US and the UK should fully support coordinated emission reductions, for example by imposing regulations on carbon emissions; meanwhile, lower-income countries can also take action, such as curbing uncontrolled deforestation.
nine-22.zh: 美国、英国等高收入国家应全力支持协调减排，例如对碳排放实施监管；与此同时，收入较低的国家也可以采取行动，例如遏制失控的森林砍伐。

nine-22.en: The need for shared responsibility and coordinated action also applies to other urgent issues, ranging from pandemics to plastic pollution.
nine-22.zh: 这种共同承担责任、协调行动的必要性，也适用于从大流行病到塑料污染等其他紧迫问题。

nine-22.en: However, each country can also take effective action according to its own circumstances.
nine-22.zh: 不过，各国也可以根据自身情况采取有效行动。

nine-22.en: In the case of global warming, international agreements to impose curbs on carbon emissions can help, but countries vary in economic, social and cultural conditions, which may give rise to urgent regional issues that local governments and residents can address independently.
nine-22.zh: 以全球变暖为例，限制碳排放的国际协议可能有所帮助，但各国的经济、社会和文化条件不同，这可能产生一些紧迫的地区性问题，而地方政府和居民能够独立处理这些问题。

nine-22.en: For example, electric cars are being encouraged in many countries to help reduce transport emissions; however, where private vehicle ownership is low, replacing existing cars may have limited immediate effects.
nine-22.zh: 例如，许多国家正在鼓励使用电动汽车，以减少交通排放；不过，在私家车拥有量较低的地方，更换现有汽车在短期内的作用可能有限。

nine-22.en: These countries may also take action to solve other problems such as plastic pollution.
nine-22.zh: 这些国家也可以采取行动解决塑料污染等其他问题。

nine-22.en: For example, where plastic waste blocks local drains and increases the risk of flooding, a local government could restrict plastic bags and improve waste collection without waiting for an international agreement.
nine-22.zh: 例如，在塑料垃圾堵塞当地排水沟、增加洪水风险的地方，地方政府可以限制塑料袋的使用并改善垃圾收集，而不必等待国际协议。

nine-22.en: Therefore, while global cooperation should be encouraged, efforts should also be made by each country, albeit differing in which problems they tackle and how they tackle them.
nine-22.zh: 因此，虽然应鼓励全球合作，各国也应作出努力，只是在处理哪些问题以及如何处理这些问题上有所不同。

nine-22.en: In conclusion, international cooperation can provide useful approaches to tackling global challenges, whereas local governments and individuals play a crucial role in implementing specific measures and addressing some urgent regional issues independently.
nine-22.zh: 总之，国际合作可以为应对全球挑战提供有益途径，而地方政府和个人在落实具体措施，以及独立解决某些紧迫的地区性问题方面发挥着关键作用。

nine-22.en: Both are central to the advancement of global society, and their relative importance depends on the scale and nature of the problem.
nine-22.zh: 两者对全球社会的进步都至关重要，其相对重要性取决于问题的规模和性质。

nine-23.en: Holding international sports tournaments has grown significantly in both economic and cultural importance; however, a fierce debate remains as to the overall effect of doing so: some people think the host country benefits a lot from it, while others argue that hosting such events is, on balance, not sensible.
nine-23.zh: 举办国际体育赛事在经济和文化方面的重要性都已显著提升；然而，人们对其总体影响仍存在激烈争论：有些人认为主办国能从中获益良多，另一些人则认为，综合来看，举办此类赛事并不明智。

nine-23.en: Both views are discussed here to seek a conclusion.
nine-23.zh: 下文将讨论这两种观点，以得出结论。

nine-23.en: The argument against such sports events is that they impose a heavy financial burden on host cities.
nine-23.zh: 反对此类体育赛事的理由是，它们给主办城市造成了沉重的财政负担。

nine-23.en: Once a city wins the bid to host international sports events (e.g., the Olympics, the World Cup, or the European Championship), a large amount of money and resources may need to be poured into preparations because cities commonly construct stadiums, transport infrastructure (e.g., roads, airports, and railways) and catering facilities.
nine-23.zh: 一座城市一旦赢得奥运会、世界杯或欧洲锦标赛等国际体育赛事的主办权，就可能需要投入大量资金和资源进行筹备，因为城市通常会兴建体育场馆、道路、机场、铁路等交通基础设施，以及餐饮设施。

nine-23.en: This can lead to substantial debt; for example, financial problems may plague a host city if construction costs exceed its available budget.
nine-23.zh: 这可能导致巨额债务；例如，如果建设成本超过可用预算，主办城市就可能陷入财政困境。

nine-23.en: Others, however, highlight that host countries can grow in stature and benefit economically and culturally.
nine-23.zh: 然而，另一些人强调，主办国能够提升国际地位，并在经济和文化上受益。

nine-23.en: Successful bidding may serve as a signal that host countries are willing to commit resources to such capital-intensive events; host countries shoulder more responsibility for organizing global events, contributing to the international community.
nine-23.zh: 申办成功可能表明，主办国愿意为此类资本密集型赛事投入资源；主办国承担更多组织全球性活动的责任，为国际社会作出贡献。

nine-23.en: With this also comes cultural exchange.
nine-23.zh: 随之而来的还有文化交流。

nine-23.en: For example, an event such as the Beijing Olympics can showcase Chinese culture and traditions to the world and give participants opportunities to learn about the cultures of other countries, thus fostering understanding and cooperation between countries.
nine-23.zh: 例如，北京奥运会这样的赛事能够向世界展示中国文化和传统，并让参与者有机会了解其他国家的文化，从而增进各国之间的理解与合作。

nine-23.en: I think the aforementioned financial burden, although a genuine concern, can be reduced.
nine-23.zh: 我认为，上述财政负担虽然确实值得关注，但可以减轻。

nine-23.en: When a country is expected to host an international sports event, opportunities abound for it to receive financial support from sponsors, such as airline companies, the food industry, and tech giants, among others; this can make hosting more financially viable.
nine-23.zh: 当一个国家即将举办国际体育赛事时，它有很多机会获得航空公司、食品企业和科技巨头等赞助商的资金支持，这可以提高举办赛事在财务上的可行性。

nine-23.en: For example, commercial sponsorship agreements could help pay for facilities and event operations.
nine-23.zh: 例如，商业赞助协议可以帮助支付设施建设和赛事运营费用。

nine-23.en: Moreover, with such events can come a boom in tourism: visitors are attracted to host countries, where revenue can be generated by selling tickets and boosting tourism.
nine-23.zh: 此外，这类赛事也可能带动旅游业繁荣：游客被吸引到主办国，而出售门票和促进旅游能够带来收入。

nine-23.en: Such revenue may offset part of the costs, although gross revenue does not by itself demonstrate a net profit.
nine-23.zh: 这些收入可能抵消部分成本，尽管总收入本身并不能证明存在净利润。

nine-23.en: In conclusion, although hosting international sports events may impose a financial burden on the host country, it can generate revenue through thriving tourism and sponsorship, alongside cultural benefits.
nine-23.zh: 总之，尽管举办国际体育赛事可能给主办国造成财政负担，但它也能通过繁荣的旅游业和赞助获得收入，并带来文化收益。

nine-23.en: I therefore support hosting such important events where expected benefits justify the costs and financial risks are carefully managed.
nine-23.zh: 因此，在预期收益足以支持相关成本、且财政风险得到审慎管理的情况下，我支持举办这类重要赛事。

nine-24.en: Opinions differ as to the decisive factor in achieving great success in sports.
nine-24.zh: 对于取得重大体育成就的决定性因素，人们持有不同看法。

nine-24.en: Some people think it rests on superior physical strength; however, others argue it hinges more on mental attitude.
nine-24.zh: 有些人认为，这取决于出众的体力；另一些人则认为，成功更依赖心理态度。

nine-24.en: Both views are discussed here to seek a conclusion.
nine-24.zh: 下文将讨论这两种观点，以得出结论。

nine-24.en: The argument in favour of the strength-oriented view is that physical fitness allows athletes to have the edge over their competitors in sporting competition.
nine-24.zh: 支持体能导向观点的理由是，良好的体能能让运动员在体育竞赛中比对手略胜一筹。

nine-24.en: Being among the fittest and strongest means athletes can perform much better in individual sports including running, swimming, and alpine skiing, among others.
nine-24.zh: 跻身体能最好、力量最强的运动员之列，意味着运动员在跑步、游泳、高山滑雪等个人项目中能够表现得更好。

nine-24.en: For example, a sprinter with exceptional speed and strength may dominate races when competitors are otherwise similarly skilled.
nine-24.zh: 例如，当其他选手的技术水平相近时，一名速度和力量都出众的短跑运动员可能在比赛中占据优势。

nine-24.en: Even in team sports such as the 4 × 100-metre relay, these physical qualities can help the team win.
nine-24.zh: 即使在4×100米接力等团队项目中，这些身体素质也能帮助团队获胜。

nine-24.en: In view of these advantages, it is hard to deny how important physical fitness is in sports competition.
nine-24.zh: 鉴于这些优势，很难否认良好体能在体育竞赛中的重要性。

nine-24.en: Others, however, highlight the importance of mental attitude.
nine-24.zh: 然而，另一些人强调心理态度的重要性。

nine-24.en: In a World Cup final, although one team may have greater physical strength, youthful energy, and a superstar striker, its opponents may still manage to lift the World Cup.
nine-24.zh: 在世界杯决赛中，尽管一支球队可能拥有更强的体力、年轻的活力和一名超级明星前锋，其对手仍有可能捧起世界杯。

nine-24.en: Mental attitude, alongside physical strength, can contribute to such success.
nine-24.zh: 除了体力，心理态度也能促成这样的成功。

nine-24.en: The winners may be a team that is greater than the sum of its parts and a team full of faith, initiative, and persistence, all of which can help them overcome strong opponents who seemingly hold all the aces.
nine-24.zh: 获胜的可能是一支整体实力大于个体实力之和、充满信念、主动精神和毅力的球队，而这些品质能帮助他们战胜那些看起来占尽优势的强大对手。

nine-24.en: I think the importance of being physically strong and mentally positive necessitates integrating the two; however, although both are important in achieving great success, the emphasis placed on each differs according to the situation and sport.
nine-24.zh: 我认为，强健体魄和积极心态的重要性意味着必须将两者结合起来；不过，尽管两者对取得重大成就都很重要，对它们的侧重会随情境和运动项目而变化。

nine-24.en: When a premium is put on speed and strength in individual sports, being physically strong can be a decisive factor, as described in the motto ‘faster, higher, stronger’; by contrast, with regard to sports involving strategy and teamwork, the fitness of every sports player is of great importance, but mental attitude allows individuals to push their limits and work much better as a team.
nine-24.zh: 在重视速度和力量的个人项目中，身体强健可能是决定性因素，正如“更快、更高、更强”这一格言所表达的那样；相比之下，在涉及策略和团队合作的运动中，每名运动员的体能都十分重要，但心理态度能让个人突破极限，并让团队合作得更好。

nine-24.en: When individuals perform well together, a team thrives.
nine-24.zh: 当个人能够共同发挥出色时，团队就会蓬勃发展。

nine-25.en: Opinions differ as to the salaries of sports professionals.
nine-25.zh: 人们对职业运动员的薪酬持有不同看法。

nine-25.en: While some people think their high salaries are fully justified, others think it is unfair that they receive a great deal more money than people in other important professions (e.g., scientists and government leaders).
nine-25.zh: 有些人认为，他们的高薪完全合理；另一些人则认为，他们的收入远高于科学家、政府领导人等其他重要职业的从业者，这是不公平的。

nine-25.en: Both views are discussed here to seek a conclusion.
nine-25.zh: 下文将讨论这两种观点，以得出结论。

nine-25.en: The argument against such high salaries for sports players is that salaries should be in proportion to the contribution individuals make to society.
nine-25.zh: 反对运动员获得如此高薪的理由是，薪酬应与个人对社会的贡献相称。

nine-25.en: Their salaries appear excessive when compared with those of top surgeons, research scientists, or even leading politicians who have responsibility for governing the country.
nine-25.zh: 与顶尖外科医生、科研人员，甚至肩负国家治理责任的重要政治人物相比，运动员的收入显得过高。

nine-25.en: From this perspective, sports players should be paid less than those people.
nine-25.zh: 从这个角度看，运动员的报酬应低于这些人。

nine-25.en: Others, however, highlight the efforts made by sports players.
nine-25.zh: 然而，另一些人强调运动员付出的努力。

nine-25.en: The number of professionals with exceptional talent is very small, and the money is a recognition of the skills and dedication a person needs to be successful.
nine-25.zh: 拥有非凡天赋的职业运动员数量很少，而这种收入是对一个人取得成功所需的技能和奉献精神的认可。

nine-25.en: Competition is constant and a player is tested every time they perform in their relatively short career.
nine-25.zh: 竞争始终存在，运动员在相对短暂的职业生涯中，每一次上场都要接受考验。

nine-25.en: The pressure from the media is intense and there is little privacy in the spotlight.
nine-25.zh: 来自媒体的压力很大，处于聚光灯下也几乎没有隐私。

nine-25.en: So all of these factors may justify the huge earnings.
nine-25.zh: 因此，所有这些因素都可能使巨额收入具有合理性。

nine-25.en: I think sports salaries are not determined solely by considering the contribution to society a person makes, or the level of responsibility he or she holds.
nine-25.zh: 我认为，体育薪酬并非仅由一个人对社会的贡献或其承担的责任大小来决定。

nine-25.en: Instead, they reflect the popularity of sports in general and the level of public support that successful stars can generate.
nine-25.zh: 相反，它们反映了体育运动总体的受欢迎程度，以及成功明星能够获得的公众支持。

nine-25.en: When supporters voluntarily pay to watch them, these players help generate commercial revenue and can reasonably receive a substantial share of it.
nine-25.zh: 当支持者自愿付费观看比赛时，这些运动员就帮助创造了商业收入，因此合理地获得其中相当大的一部分报酬是说得通的。

nine-25.en: So fairness should not be judged solely by comparing the social responsibilities of different professions.
nine-25.zh: 所以，不能仅仅比较不同职业承担的社会责任来判断公平与否。

nine-25.en: In conclusion, even though salaries are often expected to reflect contribution and responsibility, they should also be based on other considerations such as public support and the revenue generated.
nine-25.zh: 总之，尽管人们通常期望薪酬反映贡献和责任，但公众支持和所创造的收入等其他因素也应成为薪酬的依据。

nine-25.en: It is my opinion, therefore, that the amount of money sports stars make can be fully justifiable on this basis.
nine-25.zh: 因此，我认为，基于这些因素，体育明星的收入水平完全可以得到合理解释。

nine-26.en: Opinions differ as to the salaries of sports professionals.
nine-26.zh: 人们对职业运动员的薪酬持有不同看法。

nine-26.en: While some people think their high salaries are fully justified, others think it is unfair that they receive a great deal more money than people in other important professions (e.g., scientists and government leaders).
nine-26.zh: 有些人认为，他们的高薪完全合理；另一些人则认为，他们的收入远高于科学家、政府领导人等其他重要职业的从业者，这是不公平的。

nine-26.en: Both views are discussed here to seek a conclusion.
nine-26.zh: 下文将讨论这两种观点，以得出结论。

nine-26.en: The argument against such high salaries for sports players is that salaries should be in proportion to the contribution individuals make to society.
nine-26.zh: 反对运动员获得如此高薪的理由是，薪酬应与个人对社会的贡献相称。

nine-26.en: Their salaries appear excessive when compared with those of top surgeons, research scientists, or even leading politicians who have responsibility for governing the country.
nine-26.zh: 与顶尖外科医生、科研人员，甚至肩负国家治理责任的重要政治人物相比，运动员的收入显得过高。

nine-26.en: From this perspective, sports players should be paid less than those people.
nine-26.zh: 从这个角度看，运动员的报酬应低于这些人。

nine-26.en: Others, however, highlight the efforts made by sports players.
nine-26.zh: 然而，另一些人强调运动员付出的努力。

nine-26.en: The number of professionals with exceptional talent is very small, and the money is a recognition of the skills and dedication a person needs to be successful.
nine-26.zh: 拥有非凡天赋的职业运动员数量很少，而这种收入是对一个人取得成功所需的技能和奉献精神的认可。

nine-26.en: Competition is constant and a player is tested every time they perform in their relatively short career.
nine-26.zh: 竞争始终存在，运动员在相对短暂的职业生涯中，每一次上场都要接受考验。

nine-26.en: The pressure from the media is intense and there is little privacy in the spotlight.
nine-26.zh: 来自媒体的压力很大，处于聚光灯下也几乎没有隐私。

nine-26.en: So all of these factors may justify the huge earnings.
nine-26.zh: 因此，所有这些因素都可能使巨额收入具有合理性。

nine-26.en: I think sports players are overpaid when their salaries are assessed in proportion to their social contribution.
nine-26.zh: 我认为，如果按运动员对社会的贡献来衡量其薪酬，他们的收入就过高了。

nine-26.en: Scientists with exceptional talent are also few in number, and they also devote time and energy to their fields over the long term so that they can make breakthroughs.
nine-26.zh: 具有非凡天赋的科学家同样为数不多，他们也长期为自己的领域投入时间和精力，以期取得突破。

nine-26.en: For example, an agricultural scientist could develop higher-yielding rice, improving food security and providing a more reliable food supply in areas with a high risk of famine.
nine-26.zh: 例如，一位农业科学家可能培育出产量更高的水稻，改善粮食安全，并为饥荒风险较高的地区提供更可靠的粮食供应。

nine-26.en: Is pressure from the media necessarily more intense than the pressure on researchers working to help communities at risk of hunger?
nine-26.zh: 媒体带来的压力，一定比那些努力帮助面临饥饿风险的社区的研究人员所承受的压力更大吗？

nine-26.en: The same principle of rewarding scarce skills, dedication and responsibility should also apply to other important professionals.
nine-26.zh: 奖励稀缺技能、奉献精神和责任的同一原则，也应适用于其他重要职业的从业者。

nine-26.en: In conclusion, salaries should be based on contribution and responsibility.
nine-26.zh: 总之，薪酬应以贡献和责任为依据。

nine-26.en: The high salaries of sports players are difficult to justify by talent, dedication and pressure alone.
nine-26.zh: 仅凭天赋、奉献精神和压力，很难证明运动员的高薪是合理的。

nine-26.en: It is my opinion, therefore, that the amount of money sports stars make is excessive when compared with the rewards received by other professionals on the basis of their social contribution.
nine-26.zh: 因此，我认为，如果以社会贡献为依据，与其他专业人士获得的报酬相比，体育明星的收入过高。

five-a1.en: The importance of art is beyond doubt; however, opinions differ as to who can create artworks (e.g. painting, music, poetry).
five-a1.zh: 艺术的重要性毋庸置疑；然而，对于谁能创作绘画、音乐、诗歌等艺术作品，人们持有不同看法。

five-a1.en: Some believe that they can be made by every individual, whereas others argue they can only be produced by people with certain skills and abilities.
five-a1.zh: 有些人认为，每个人都可以创作艺术作品，另一些人则认为，只有具备一定技能和能力的人才能创作。

five-a1.en: I believe anyone can create art for self-expression, although producing widely acclaimed work generally requires greater skill.
five-a1.zh: 我认为，任何人都可以通过艺术表达自我，尽管创作广受赞誉的作品通常需要更高的技艺。

five-a1.en: The primary justification for everyone’s artistic potential resides in the very nature of art.
five-a1.zh: 认为每个人都具备艺术潜力，其主要依据在于艺术本身的性质。

five-a1.en: Art is a channel for people to express their unique ideas and experiences through various art mediums, ranging from poems to paintings.
five-a1.zh: 艺术是人们通过从诗歌到绘画等各种艺术媒介，表达独特想法和经历的途径。

five-a1.en: For example, drawing is a popular art form with a low barrier to entry, and as long as creators have a pen and a piece of paper, no matter which culture or generation they belong to, they can create art freely.
five-a1.zh: 例如，绘画是一种门槛较低的流行艺术形式，只要创作者有一支笔和一张纸，无论他们属于哪种文化或哪一代人，都能自由创作。

five-a1.en: Others, however, highlight that artworks should be distinguished by their high quality.
five-a1.zh: 然而，另一些人强调，艺术作品应以其高品质而脱颖而出。

five-a1.en: Creations such as poems and musical compositions that are widely recognised as significant works of art usually demonstrate a high level of technical skill or a perceptive understanding of social phenomena.
five-a1.zh: 被广泛认可为重要艺术作品的诗歌、音乐作品等创作，通常展现出高超的技艺，或对社会现象敏锐的理解。

five-a1.en: Although everyone can try to create a work of art, a widely acclaimed piece generally requires more developed skills and abilities.
five-a1.zh: 尽管每个人都可以尝试创作艺术作品，但一件广受赞誉的作品通常需要更成熟的技能和能力。

five-a1.en: I think opinions vary according to the definition of art.
five-a1.zh: 我认为，看法上的差异取决于对艺术的定义。

five-a1.en: Although art per se should be regarded as a way to represent things or express ideas, the artworks that people usually talk about are often those recognised for their artistic value and, sometimes, their commercial value, behind which are the talent and extensive training of the artists.
five-a1.zh: 虽然艺术本身应被视为再现事物或表达思想的方式，但人们通常谈论的艺术作品，往往是那些因艺术价值、有时也因商业价值而得到认可的作品，其背后是艺术家的天赋和大量训练。

five-a1.en: This helps to explain why widely acclaimed artworks are often made by professionals, be they musicians or writers.
five-a1.zh: 这有助于解释，为什么广受赞誉的艺术作品往往出自专业人士之手，无论是音乐家还是作家。

five-a1.en: All can create art in ways that they want; not all can create art that gains wide recognition.
five-a1.zh: 所有人都可以按自己想要的方式创作艺术，但并非所有人都能创作出获得广泛认可的作品。

five-a2.en: The importance of science and technology is beyond doubt; however, many people still value the arts despite a growing emphasis on science and technology.
five-a2.zh: 科学技术的重要性毋庸置疑；不过，尽管人们日益重视科学技术，许多人仍然珍视艺术。

five-a2.en: This occurs for several reasons, foremost of which is the fact that the arts convey human experience and aesthetic values in ways that scientific explanation alone cannot fully capture.
five-a2.zh: 这有几个原因，其中最主要的是，艺术能够以科学解释本身无法充分涵盖的方式，传达人类经验和审美价值。

five-a2.en: The underlying reason for the importance of the arts is that they allow for self-expression, be it for individuals or society.
five-a2.zh: 艺术之所以重要，根本原因在于它让个人或社会都能表达自我。

five-a2.en: For individuals, the ability to express themselves is a crucial element of being fully human and maintaining mental well-being.
five-a2.zh: 对个人而言，表达自己的能力，是完整地作为人生活、并保持心理健康的重要组成部分。

five-a2.en: Through painting, music, and dance, people can express their thoughts and feelings and help others understand what experiences such as joy or loss feel like from the inside.
five-a2.zh: 通过绘画、音乐和舞蹈，人们能够表达自己的想法和感受，并帮助他人从内在体验的角度，理解喜悦或失落等经历是什么滋味。

five-a2.en: For society as a whole, artworks can partly reflect shared values and enrich cultural life.
five-a2.zh: 对整个社会而言，艺术作品可以在一定程度上反映共同价值观，丰富文化生活。

five-a2.en: When people visit museums or art galleries, they appreciate paintings or sculptures created by artists so that they can gain a better understanding of the past, ranging from what gives one period its distinctive character to how values and morality have changed.
five-a2.zh: 人们参观博物馆或美术馆时，会欣赏艺术家创作的绘画或雕塑，从而更好地理解过去，包括某个时代的独特之处，以及价值观和道德观念如何发生变化。

five-a2.en: The same principle also applies to stories written by writers and music by musicians.
five-a2.zh: 同一道理也适用于作家创作的故事和音乐家创作的音乐。

five-a2.en: In addition, art reveals the aesthetic value of everyday life, while science helps to explain how things function.
five-a2.zh: 此外，艺术揭示日常生活中的审美价值，而科学有助于解释事物如何运作。

five-a2.en: Although science is capable of making tangible improvements in the lives of individuals, technical function alone does not determine what people find beautiful or meaningful.
five-a2.zh: 尽管科学能够切实改善个人生活，但技术功能本身并不能决定人们觉得什么是美丽或有意义的。

five-a2.en: For example, the appeal of a smartphone may rest ultimately not only on its operating system but also on its industrial design.
five-a2.zh: 例如，一部智能手机的吸引力，最终可能不仅取决于它的操作系统，也取决于它的工业设计。

five-a2.en: Science and technology provide the system itself, but art helps to shape its visual appearance, showing how people seek beauty even in objects designed for practical use.
five-a2.zh: 科学技术提供系统本身，而艺术帮助塑造其视觉外观，这说明人们即使在为实用而设计的物品中，也会追求美。

five-a2.en: In conclusion, the arts still occupy a prominent position in society as they convey personal feelings, shared cultural experiences and aesthetic values.
five-a2.zh: 总之，艺术仍在社会中占据重要地位，因为它能够传达个人情感、共同的文化体验和审美价值。

five-a2.en: These perspectives complement scientific knowledge, which helps to explain the world but does not by itself fully communicate what it feels like to live in it.
five-a2.zh: 这些视角与科学知识相辅相成：科学知识有助于解释世界，却无法单凭自身充分传达生活在这个世界中的感受。

five-a3.en: There is a fierce debate about how governments allocate budgets.
five-a3.zh: 对于政府如何分配预算，人们存在激烈争论。

five-a3.en: It is proposed that the money allocated to art (e.g., music and painting) should be channelled into improving public services.
five-a3.zh: 有人提议，应将分配给音乐、绘画等艺术领域的资金转用于改善公共服务。

five-a3.en: Although essential needs for such services should be met, I disagree that arts funding should be withdrawn, as other considerations justify continued investment in the arts.
five-a3.zh: 尽管公共服务的基本需求应得到满足，但我不同意撤回艺术经费，因为其他考量也足以支持继续投资艺术。

five-a3.en: The argument in favour of public services is that people can directly benefit from such investment.
five-a3.zh: 支持公共服务的理由是，人们能从这类投资中直接受益。

five-a3.en: Many cities’ public services are inadequate; for example, accessible public facilities may be damaged or ill-maintained in some cities, causing a lot of inconvenience to people with disabilities.
five-a3.zh: 许多城市的公共服务并不完善；例如，一些城市的无障碍公共设施可能损坏或维护不善，给残障人士带来诸多不便。

five-a3.en: If more money were to be allocated to public services, this would allow them to live more independently and travel with fewer barriers, which is an important element of a humane and civilized society serving all rather than most.
five-a3.zh: 如果为公共服务分配更多资金，就能让他们更独立地生活、出行时遇到更少障碍，这是一个服务所有人、而不只是大多数人的人道文明社会的重要组成部分。

five-a3.en: Those people could benefit directly from such improvements, which may be more urgent than additional spending on music or painting.
five-a3.zh: 这些人可以从此类改善中直接获益，而这些改善可能比增加音乐或绘画支出更为紧迫。

five-a3.en: However, it does not necessarily mean that there is no justification for investment in the arts.
five-a3.zh: 不过，这并不必然意味着艺术投资就没有合理依据。

five-a3.en: For individuals, the ability to express themselves is a crucial element of being fully human and maintaining mental well-being.
five-a3.zh: 对个人而言，表达自己的能力，是完整地作为人生活、并保持心理健康的重要组成部分。

five-a3.en: This explains the popularity of classes for painting, music, and dance as a means of relaxing and expressing one’s thoughts and feelings.
five-a3.zh: 这解释了为什么绘画、音乐和舞蹈课程广受欢迎，因为它们是放松身心、表达想法和感受的方式。

five-a3.en: For society, artwork can partly reflect shared values and enrich cultural life.
five-a3.zh: 对社会而言，艺术作品可以在一定程度上反映共同价值观，丰富文化生活。

five-a3.en: When people visit museums or art galleries, they appreciate paintings or sculptures created by artists so that they can gain a better understanding of the past, ranging from what gives one period its distinctive character to how values and morality have changed.
five-a3.zh: 人们参观博物馆或美术馆时，会欣赏艺术家创作的绘画或雕塑，从而更好地理解过去，包括某个时代的独特之处，以及价值观和道德观念如何发生变化。

five-a3.en: Moreover, it is worthwhile to point out that once essential public service needs have been met, allocating all arts funding to further service improvements may bring only limited additional benefits.
five-a3.zh: 此外，值得指出的是，一旦公共服务的基本需求已经得到满足，将全部艺术经费投入进一步改善公共服务，可能只能带来有限的额外收益。

five-a3.en: This reflects the principle of diminishing returns: beyond a certain point, each additional unit of investment in a particular area may produce a smaller additional benefit.
five-a3.zh: 这体现了边际收益递减原则：超过某个限度后，向特定领域每增加一单位投资，可能带来更小的额外收益。

five-a3.en: In such circumstances, transferring a modest arts budget may make little difference to public services; by contrast, retaining it could preserve valuable opportunities for artistic participation and appreciation.
five-a3.zh: 在这种情况下，转移数额不大的艺术预算，可能对公共服务改善作用甚微；相比之下，保留这笔经费可以维护宝贵的艺术参与和欣赏机会。

five-a3.en: In conclusion, even though urgent needs for public services should be satisfied, continued investment in the arts is justified in view of its cultural and personal benefits.
five-a3.zh: 总之，尽管公共服务的紧迫需求应得到满足，但考虑到艺术带来的文化和个人收益，持续投资艺术是合理的。

five-a3.en: Budget allocation should be guided by a clear set of criteria that balances essential service needs with opportunities for cultural participation.
five-a3.zh: 预算分配应以一套清晰的标准为指导，在基本公共服务需求与文化参与机会之间取得平衡。

five-b1.en: There has been a fierce yet unresolved debate as to how the government allocates its budget.
five-b1.zh: 对于政府如何分配预算，一直存在激烈而尚无定论的争论。

five-b1.en: It is proposed that the money allocated to the renovation and preservation of old buildings should be channelled into road development.
five-b1.zh: 有人提议，应将分配给老建筑翻修和保护的资金转用于道路建设。

five-b1.en: Although the demand for road development should be met, other considerations justify the policies adopted to preserve and restore these buildings.
five-b1.zh: 尽管道路建设的需求应得到满足，其他考量也足以支持保护和修复这些建筑的政策。

five-b1.en: The argument in favour of road construction is that it can greatly contribute to city dwellers’ well-being.
five-b1.zh: 支持道路建设的理由是，它能极大增进城市居民的福祉。

five-b1.en: Many commuters are negatively affected by traffic, mentally and physically, especially the heavy traffic during rush hours.
five-b1.zh: 许多通勤者的身心都受到交通状况的不利影响，尤其是上下班高峰时段的拥堵。

five-b1.en: If more money were to be allocated to road development, ranging from the construction of flyovers to the removal of traffic bottlenecks, fewer commuters might complain about the experience of getting stuck in traffic for hours.
five-b1.zh: 如果为道路建设分配更多资金，开展从修建立交桥到消除交通瓶颈等工程，抱怨堵车数小时的通勤者可能会减少。

five-b1.en: It seems, therefore, that citizens can benefit from such reasonable budget allocation.
five-b1.zh: 因此，市民似乎能够从这种合理的预算分配中受益。

five-b1.en: However, it does not necessarily mean that there is no justification for the preservation of old buildings.
five-b1.zh: 然而，这并不必然意味着保护老建筑就没有合理依据。

five-b1.en: Many of these buildings reflect the beauty of local culture and heritage.
five-b1.zh: 许多老建筑体现了当地文化和遗产之美。

five-b1.en: Would future generations recognize their cultural identity as readily if much of the physical evidence were to be erased?
five-b1.zh: 如果大量实物证据被抹去，后代还能同样容易地认同自己的文化身份吗？

five-b1.en: Probably not if all these old buildings disappeared and only anonymous housing estates remained.
five-b1.zh: 如果这些老建筑全部消失，剩下的只有缺乏特色的住宅区，恐怕就不能了。

five-b1.en: In addition, restored buildings can act as an economic engine, drawing tourists from all over the world.
five-b1.zh: 此外，修复后的建筑还能吸引世界各地的游客，成为经济发展的引擎。

five-b1.en: A city, for example, could preserve an old temple, capitalizing on its cultural and historic flavour to attract tourists.
five-b1.zh: 例如，一座城市可以保护一座古寺，利用其文化和历史韵味吸引游客。

five-b1.en: Therefore, the attempt to maintain such old buildings is justifiable.
five-b1.zh: 因此，维护这些老建筑是有道理的。

five-b1.en: Moreover, it is worthwhile to point out that if the money allocated to maintaining old buildings were to be spent on other important things (e.g., road development), the situation might improve little where road infrastructure is already well developed.
five-b1.zh: 此外，值得指出的是，如果将维护老建筑的资金用于道路建设等其他重要事项，在道路基础设施已经完善的地方，情况可能也不会改善多少。

five-b1.en: This can be explained by the principle of diminishing returns, which means that as investment in a particular area increases, the additional benefit from each unit of investment may decline after a certain point.
five-b1.zh: 这可以用边际收益递减原则解释，即随着对特定领域的投资增加，超过某个限度后，每单位投资带来的额外收益可能下降。

five-b1.en: In such circumstances, the proposal may bring only limited improvements; by contrast, governments and citizens can benefit culturally from old buildings even when their preservation is supported by a relatively small proportion of the government budget.
five-b1.zh: 在这种情况下，这项提议可能只能带来有限改善；相比之下，即使老建筑保护仅占政府预算的较小部分，政府和市民仍能从老建筑中获得文化收益。

five-b1.en: In conclusion, even though the high demand for road development should be satisfied, the preservation of old buildings is indispensable in view of their cultural and economic importance.
five-b1.zh: 总之，尽管道路建设的巨大需求应得到满足，但鉴于老建筑的文化和经济价值，保护它们不可或缺。

five-b1.en: Funding for preservation should therefore be maintained, with budget allocations carefully made according to a strict set of criteria that balances transport needs with heritage protection.
five-b1.zh: 因此，应保留保护经费，并依照严格的标准审慎分配预算，在交通需求与遗产保护之间取得平衡。

five-b2.en: One of the worrying trends in modern society is that people do not get enough regular exercise.
five-b2.zh: 现代社会令人担忧的趋势之一，是人们没有获得足够的经常性锻炼。

five-b2.en: Some policymakers propose that all towns and cities should allocate funds to build more outdoor areas, such as squares and parks.
five-b2.zh: 一些政策制定者提议，所有城镇都应拨款建设更多广场、公园等户外空间。

five-b2.en: Although this proposal can seemingly mitigate public health concerns, it is not necessarily financially viable or effective in every town or city.
five-b2.zh: 尽管这项提议看起来能缓解公共健康问题，但它在每个城镇未必都具有财务可行性或实际效果。

five-b2.en: The argument in favour of this proposal is that it can encourage citizens to exercise.
five-b2.zh: 支持这项提议的理由是，它可以鼓励市民锻炼。

five-b2.en: Today’s sedentary lifestyle and stressful working conditions can mean that physical activity is no longer a regular part of either our work or our leisure time; this problem is exacerbated where insufficient public outdoor activity space is provided.
five-b2.zh: 当今久坐的生活方式和高压工作环境，可能意味着体育活动已不再是工作或闲暇生活中的固定组成部分；在缺乏公共户外活动空间的地方，这个问题还会加剧。

five-b2.en: If the policy of increasing park space were to be adopted, the new outdoor public places would offer people more space to do some physical activities (e.g., jogging and taking a walk), thus helping to mitigate the problem of declining public health.
five-b2.zh: 如果增加公园空间的政策得到采纳，新的户外公共场所将为人们提供更多慢跑、散步等体育活动的空间，从而有助于缓解公众健康下降的问题。

five-b2.en: It seems sensible, therefore, to adopt this proposal where such facilities are lacking.
five-b2.zh: 因此，在缺乏这类设施的地方采纳这一提议，似乎是合理的。

five-b2.en: However, the effort to enable all towns and cities to build more public spaces may be difficult to sustain, as it presumes that all governments have extra money to implement this policy.
five-b2.zh: 不过，让所有城镇都建设更多公共空间的做法可能难以持续，因为它假定所有政府都有额外资金来实施这项政策。

five-b2.en: Governments have to budget carefully to meet demands from every field, ranging from healthcare services and public transport to the state pension system, which means they may have limited scope to increase the amount of money allocated to public facilities.
five-b2.zh: 政府必须谨慎编制预算，以满足从医疗服务、公共交通到国家养老金制度等各个领域的需求，这意味着它们增加公共设施拨款的空间可能有限。

five-b2.en: For some less affluent regions, large outdoor spaces require construction expenses and ongoing maintenance costs (e.g., waste management), which may mean cuts to spending in other fields.
five-b2.zh: 对一些不太富裕的地区而言，大型户外空间需要建设费用，以及垃圾管理等持续的维护开支，这可能意味着削减其他领域的支出。

five-b2.en: Moreover, it is not simply the lack of outdoor activity space but also a heavy workload or study burden that can discourage people from exercising regularly.
five-b2.zh: 此外，使人们难以坚持锻炼的，不仅是缺少户外活动空间，还有繁重的工作或学习负担。

five-b2.en: Therefore, the worrying situation may continue if people still lack time to go to parks or squares to take a walk.
five-b2.zh: 因此，如果人们仍没有时间到公园或广场散步，这种令人担忧的状况就可能持续。

five-b2.en: The decline in public health could be addressed by helping people realize the importance of exercising regularly and making time for it in work and study schedules, prompting people to make full use of existing outdoor activity space to exercise.
five-b2.zh: 要应对公众健康下降的问题，可以帮助人们认识经常锻炼的重要性，并在工作和学习安排中留出锻炼时间，从而促使他们充分利用现有户外活动空间进行锻炼。

five-b2.en: Although declining public health warrants attention, it is not necessarily financially viable for all cities and towns to build more outdoor activity spaces.
five-b2.zh: 尽管公共健康下降值得关注，但让所有城镇都建设更多户外活动空间，在财务上未必可行。

five-b2.en: This proposal may have little effect where lack of time remains the main barrier, and thus success in improving public health also rests on improved health awareness and opportunities to exercise, rather than extra facilities and spaces alone.
five-b2.zh: 在缺乏时间仍是主要障碍的地方，这项提议可能收效甚微，因此改善公共健康的成功，也有赖于提高健康意识和增加锻炼机会，而不仅是增建设施和空间。

five-b3.en: One of the worrying trends in modern society is that people spend too much time commuting; therefore, a fierce debate rages as to the best way to mitigate this problem.
five-b3.zh: 现代社会令人担忧的趋势之一，是人们在通勤上花费过多时间；因此，关于如何最好地缓解这一问题，存在激烈争论。

five-b3.en: Some propose to replace parks and gardens in the city centre with apartment buildings.
five-b3.zh: 有人提议，将市中心的公园和花园改建成公寓楼。

five-b3.en: Although this proposal can seemingly mitigate the problem, I do not regard it as the best solution, as it overlooks other major causes of long commuting times and sacrifices valuable green spaces.
five-b3.zh: 尽管这项提议似乎能够缓解问题，但我不认为它是最佳解决方案，因为它忽视了通勤时间过长的其他主要原因，也牺牲了宝贵的绿地。

five-b3.en: The argument in favour of this policy is that it can greatly reduce the time spent commuting.
five-b3.zh: 支持这项政策的理由是，它能大幅减少通勤时间。

five-b3.en: Commuters with a limited budget may choose a residential area on the periphery of the city, which means they have to get up early, catch the early bus or train, and arrive at their workplaces on time.
five-b3.zh: 预算有限的通勤者可能选择城市边缘的住宅区，这意味着他们必须早起，赶早班公交或火车，才能准时到达工作地点。

five-b3.en: If the proposal were to be adopted, more apartments would become available to those commuters; provided these homes were affordable and close to their workplaces, this could allow them to spend less time travelling and have more time to sleep and relax.
five-b3.zh: 如果这项提议得到采纳，这些通勤者就能获得更多公寓；假如这些住房价格可负担，而且靠近工作地点，就能让他们减少出行时间，拥有更多睡眠和放松的时间。

five-b3.en: It seems, therefore, sensible to build more residential buildings in the city centre.
five-b3.zh: 因此，在市中心建设更多住宅楼似乎是合理的。

five-b3.en: However, such an attempt to replace green areas may have limited effects, as it overlooks other important causes of long commuting times.
five-b3.zh: 不过，这种取代绿地的做法可能效果有限，因为它忽视了通勤时间过长的其他重要原因。

five-b3.en: While distance certainly plays a role, people may also spend too much time commuting because of slow-moving traffic.
five-b3.zh: 虽然距离确实有影响，但交通行驶缓慢也可能使人们花费过多时间通勤。

five-b3.en: As is often the case, commuters leave their homes quite early but still are stuck in heavy traffic.
five-b3.zh: 常见的情况是，通勤者很早就离开家，却仍然堵在路上。

five-b3.en: To reduce commuting time, two improvements may have far-reaching effects, the first being measures to improve traffic flow.
five-b3.zh: 为了减少通勤时间，两项改善可能产生深远影响，首先是改善交通流动状况的措施。

five-b3.en: This may require more investment in road infrastructure, ranging from the construction of flyovers to the removal of traffic bottlenecks, which can make it less likely for traffic to build up.
five-b3.zh: 这可能需要增加对道路基础设施的投资，包括从修建立交桥到消除交通瓶颈等工程，从而降低交通拥堵形成的可能性。

five-b3.en: Commuters who travel by road can benefit from this.
five-b3.zh: 通过道路出行的通勤者能够从中受益。

five-b3.en: Moreover, the distance from the company to the home can be reduced by relocating some companies to the inner suburbs, provided this brings them closer to where their employees live.
five-b3.zh: 此外，可以将部分公司搬迁至近郊，以缩短公司与住宅之间的距离，前提是这样确实能让公司更靠近员工的居住地。

five-b3.en: Replacing parks and gardens is unacceptable due to their importance to citizens as places for recreation and exercise; by contrast, it may be more viable for some companies or factories to relocate where commercial rents are lower in the suburbs than in city centres and suitable land is available without sacrificing public green spaces.
five-b3.zh: 公园和花园作为市民休闲和锻炼的场所十分重要，因此取代它们是不可接受的；相比之下，如果郊区商业租金低于市中心，且有适宜用地而不必牺牲公共绿地，一些公司或工厂搬迁可能更可行。

five-b3.en: In conclusion, the proposal to replace parks and gardens with residential areas is not the best solution, in view of the other causes of long commuting times and the value of public green spaces.
five-b3.zh: 总之，鉴于通勤时间过长的其他原因，以及公共绿地的价值，将公园和花园改建成住宅并非最佳解决方案。

five-b3.en: Other sensible programmes, such as improving road conditions and relocating companies, should be considered where appropriate to reduce the time spent commuting without sacrificing those spaces.
five-b3.zh: 应在适宜的情况下考虑改善道路状况、搬迁公司等其他合理方案，在不牺牲这些空间的前提下减少通勤时间。

five-b4.en: Urban planning has grown significantly in social importance.
five-b4.zh: 城市规划在社会层面的重要性已经显著提升。

five-b4.en: With the contribution made by public parks and sports facilities comes the belief that it is essential to construct more of them than shopping centres if new towns are planned.
five-b4.zh: 公共公园和体育设施所带来的益处，使人们认为，在规划新城镇时，有必要建设数量多于购物中心的公园和体育设施。

five-b4.en: Even though the importance of parks and sports facilities is beyond doubt, it does not necessarily mean higher priority should be accorded to them than to shopping centres.
five-b4.zh: 尽管公园和体育设施的重要性毋庸置疑，但这并不必然意味着它们应比购物中心享有更高的优先地位。

five-b4.en: The primary justification for insisting on more parks and sports facilities resides in the belief that the existence of public parks can help people remain healthy, physically and mentally.
five-b4.zh: 主张建设更多公园和体育设施的主要依据，是人们相信公共公园的存在有助于保持身心健康。

five-b4.en: The heavy demands of modern life have long been contributing to a sedentary lifestyle, and people often find it hard to exercise outside, thus giving rise to physical health problems.
five-b4.zh: 现代生活的繁重要求长期以来促成了久坐的生活方式，人们也常常觉得难以到户外锻炼，从而产生身体健康问题。

five-b4.en: If this proposal were to be adopted, low-cost sports facilities would become more available and accessible to local residents, especially those who are unable to afford a gym membership, encouraging them to be more actively engaged in physical exercise, ranging from going jogging to taking a brisk walk.
five-b4.zh: 如果这一提议得到采纳，当地居民就能更方便地获得和使用低成本体育设施，尤其是那些无力负担健身房会员费的人，这会鼓励他们更积极地参与从慢跑到快走等体育锻炼。

five-b4.en: Moreover, parks are ideal places for the members of a community to assemble, socialize and interact, which could not only build a sense of community but also contribute to their mental well-being.
five-b4.zh: 此外，公园也是社区成员聚集、社交和互动的理想场所，不仅有助于建立社区归属感，还可能增进心理健康。

five-b4.en: It seems, therefore, sensible to build more parks and sports facilities.
five-b4.zh: 因此，建设更多公园和体育设施似乎是合理的。

five-b4.en: However, reaching such a conclusion does not necessarily mean that more public parks or sports facilities should be built than shopping centres.
five-b4.zh: 不过，得出这一结论，并不必然意味着公共公园或体育设施的建设数量应多于购物中心。

five-b4.en: Shopping malls can be multifunctional complexes, making them not only shopping destinations but also places in which people can satisfy their needs for socialising, recreation, exercise and relaxation, among other things.
five-b4.zh: 购物中心可以是多功能综合体，不只是购物目的地，也是满足人们社交、休闲、锻炼和放松等需求的场所。

five-b4.en: Moreover, people may prefer such retail centres as they provide a wide range of basic necessities and fashion brands, the opportunity to shop in one place to save time, and convenient parking facilities; their indoor areas can also provide shelter from bad weather, be it in summer or winter.
five-b4.zh: 此外，人们可能更喜欢这类零售中心，因为它们提供种类丰富的生活必需品和时尚品牌，能够让人一站式购物、节省时间，并提供便利的停车设施；无论夏季还是冬季，其室内区域还可以遮蔽恶劣天气。

five-b4.en: In conclusion, in view of the advantages of parks and sports facilities and the essential role played by shopping malls, it is more reasonable and realistic to build them in accordance with the needs of the newly planned town, rather than assuming that the number of parks and sports facilities must exceed that of shopping centres.
five-b4.zh: 总之，考虑到公园和体育设施的好处，以及购物中心发挥的必要作用，根据新规划城镇的实际需求进行建设，会更加合理、现实，而不应假定公园和体育设施的数量必须超过购物中心。

five-t1.en: Television has grown significantly in educational importance; therefore, with such benefits comes a proposal that watching television should be a regular part of children’s lives, be it at home or school.
five-t1.zh: 电视在教育方面的重要性已经显著提升；因此，基于这些好处，有人提议，无论在家里还是在学校，看电视都应成为儿童生活的常规部分。

five-t1.en: Despite the tangible benefits, watching TV regularly at school can be counterproductive if it replaces teacher-led instruction, while it can be allowed at home with proper supervision.
five-t1.zh: 尽管电视具有切实的好处，但如果经常在学校看电视取代了教师主导的教学，就可能适得其反；而在家中，只要有适当监督，则可以允许儿童观看。

five-t1.en: The argument in favour of TV-watching activities at home and school is that they can maximise the educational benefits that accrue to children.
five-t1.zh: 支持在家和学校开展看电视活动的理由，是这样可以最大限度地发挥电视对儿童的教育益处。

five-t1.en: TV programmes, ranging from documentaries about the natural world to cartoons made for children such as Mickey Mouse, can help students gain a better understanding of the world.
five-t1.zh: 从介绍自然世界的纪录片，到《米老鼠》等为儿童制作的动画片，各类电视节目都能帮助学生更好地了解世界。

five-t1.en: Attracted by the visual images and conversations between characters, students can learn about the diversity of ecosystems and the environmental problems humans are facing, while also acquiring useful daily expressions.
five-t1.zh: 学生被画面和人物之间的对话吸引，能够了解生态系统的多样性，以及人类面临的环境问题，同时学到有用的日常表达。

five-t1.en: If this proposal were to be adopted, their opportunities to learn from such programmes could increase, provided that suitable content were selected.
five-t1.zh: 如果这项提议得到采纳，只要选择适当的内容，他们从此类节目中学习的机会就可能增加。

five-t1.en: It seems, therefore, sensible to make such a change.
five-t1.zh: 因此，作出这样的改变似乎是合理的。

five-t1.en: However, such attempts to encourage students to watch TV at school can be counterproductive if they displace teacher-led instruction.
five-t1.zh: 不过，如果鼓励学生在学校看电视的做法取代了教师主导的教学，就可能适得其反。

five-t1.en: TV programmes, albeit contributing to the acquisition of knowledge, may fail to help students acquire knowledge systematically without guidance.
five-t1.zh: 电视节目虽然有助于获取知识，但如果没有指导，可能无法帮助学生系统地掌握知识。

five-t1.en: For example, students may be amazed at how plants manage to attract insects to pollinate them when they are watching documentaries, but it is teachers who can impart the knowledge gradually, effectively, and systematically, including what pollination is and why plants need pollination.
five-t1.zh: 例如，观看纪录片时，学生可能惊叹于植物如何吸引昆虫为其授粉，但能够循序渐进、有效而系统地传授授粉是什么、植物为什么需要授粉等知识的，仍是教师。

five-t1.en: In view of this, school time that should be used to listen to, discuss ideas with and learn from teachers should not routinely be replaced by such seemingly educationally beneficial screen time.
five-t1.zh: 因此，本应用来听教师讲解、与教师讨论并向教师学习的在校时间，不应经常被这种看起来有教育价值的屏幕时间取代。

five-t1.en: Nonetheless, after school, students can be allowed to watch TV programmes regularly, with limitations on what kind of programmes they watch and how long they can watch.
five-t1.zh: 不过，放学之后可以允许学生经常观看电视节目，同时限制节目类型和观看时长。

five-t1.en: When children are free to watch TV without supervision, problems may arise - they may spend too much time on entertaining programmes just for fun.
five-t1.zh: 如果儿童在没有监督的情况下自由看电视，就可能出现问题，例如为了娱乐而在娱乐节目上花费过多时间。

five-t1.en: In addition, too much screen time may cause eye strain and make children prone to lead a sedentary lifestyle when it replaces outdoor activity, possible negative effects that can be mitigated by taking screen breaks regularly and limiting the number of hours children can watch.
five-t1.zh: 此外，当过长的屏幕时间取代户外活动时，还可能造成眼睛疲劳，并使儿童容易形成久坐的生活方式；通过定期暂停观看、让眼睛休息，以及限制观看时长，可以缓解这些潜在负面影响。

five-t1.en: Those potential problems necessitate parental guidance to help children seek a compromise between the recreational side and the educational side.
five-t1.zh: 这些潜在问题意味着家长有必要提供指导，帮助儿童在娱乐与教育之间取得平衡。

five-t1.en: In conclusion, although the educational importance of TV is clear, encouraging students to watch it regularly at school is unnecessary if this displaces teacher-led instruction.
five-t1.zh: 总之，尽管电视的教育价值显而易见，但如果经常在学校看电视会取代教师主导的教学，便没有必要鼓励这样做。

five-t1.en: Children can still be allowed to do it regularly at home, but this requires guidance from parents to help children act with moderation.
five-t1.zh: 仍然可以允许儿童经常在家看电视，但这需要家长引导，帮助他们适度观看。

five-t2.en: One of the growing trends in modern society is that people increasingly prefer to watch television shows or other programmes alone.
five-t2.zh: 现代社会日益明显的趋势之一，是人们越来越喜欢独自观看电视节目或其他节目。

five-t2.en: Thus, a fierce debate rages over its overall effect.
five-t2.zh: 因此，关于这一趋势的总体影响，存在激烈争论。

five-t2.en: Despite the potential for emotional isolation, this trend, on balance, can produce a positive outcome when other social activities are maintained in the form of respect for individual preferences and greater flexibility in the viewing process.
five-t2.zh: 尽管存在情感孤立的可能，但只要其他社交活动得以保持，综合来看，这一趋势可以带来积极结果，具体表现为个人偏好得到尊重、观看过程更加灵活。

five-t2.en: One of the tangible benefits of watching shows alone is that it liberates viewers from having to compromise with others regarding what shows they can watch and how they watch them.
five-t2.zh: 独自观看节目的一项切实好处，是观众不必再为了看什么、怎样看而与他人妥协。

five-t2.en: When people sit at home, ready to watch movies with others, problems may arise.
five-t2.zh: 当人们坐在家中，准备与他人一起看电影时，可能会出现问题。

five-t2.en: If they want to watch a suspense movie and their significant other wants a romantic movie, one of them may end up watching a less preferable film.
five-t2.zh: 如果自己想看悬疑片，而伴侣想看爱情片，那么其中一人最终可能只能观看一部不太喜欢的电影。

five-t2.en: At the same time, when they watch alone, they can pause, switch to another programme, re-watch shows, and switch between a variety of portable devices.
five-t2.zh: 与此同时，独自观看时，人们可以暂停、换台、重看节目，也可以在多种便携设备之间切换。

five-t2.en: These decisions do not require negotiation with others and can be made depending on their mood and preferences.
five-t2.zh: 这些决定无需与他人协商，可以依据自己的心情和偏好作出。

five-t2.en: However, such individual activities can reduce opportunities for social contact and communication.
five-t2.zh: 不过，这类独自进行的活动可能减少社交接触和交流的机会。

five-t2.en: Traditionally, people spend time watching films with friends or family members, and in doing so, they discuss them, joke about them, and have later conversations about them.
five-t2.zh: 过去，人们会花时间与朋友或家人一起看电影，并在观看时讨论、开玩笑，之后也会继续谈论。

five-t2.en: Currently, problems may arise when people are watching shows alone because they have fewer opportunities to forge and strengthen bonds with others.
five-t2.zh: 如今，人们独自观看节目时可能出现问题，因为他们与他人建立和加强联系的机会更少。

five-t2.en: Nonetheless, the scale of such problems may be exaggerated when people maintain other shared activities.
five-t2.zh: 不过，只要人们保持其他共同活动，这类问题的程度就可能被夸大了。

five-t2.en: It is the conversation and interaction that matter most, and although people do not communicate with others while watching television programmes alone, they are still able to share their ideas and interact with others when they are having dinner together, taking a walk or going shopping.
five-t2.zh: 最重要的是交谈和互动；虽然人们独自看电视时不与他人交流，但在一起吃饭、散步或购物时，仍然能够分享想法、与他人互动。

five-t2.en: In conclusion, although viewers have fewer opportunities for interaction while watching alone, interpersonal communication that occurs in daily life can suffice to meet their social needs when they maintain other shared activities.
five-t2.zh: 总之，尽管独自观看时观众的互动机会较少，但只要他们保持其他共同活动，日常生活中的人际交流就足以满足社交需求。

five-t2.en: On balance, the convenience and flexibility of watching alone can therefore outweigh this disadvantage.
five-t2.zh: 因此，综合来看，独自观看的便利性和灵活性能够超过这一缺点。

five-t3.en: Opinions differ as to the effects of television on children.
five-t3.zh: 对于电视对儿童的影响，人们持有不同看法。

five-t3.en: Some anti-television activists claim that watching television is detrimental to children in every aspect; however, others such as educationalists argue that it acts as a catalyst for children to acquire knowledge.
five-t3.zh: 一些反对儿童看电视的人声称，看电视在各方面都对儿童有害；而教育工作者等其他人则认为，它能促进儿童获取知识。

five-t3.en: Both views merit consideration, although I believe that moderation and adult guidance are essential.
five-t3.zh: 两种观点都值得考虑，尽管我认为，适度观看和成人指导至关重要。

five-t3.en: The argument against television is that it can give rise to problems, be they physical or behavioural.
five-t3.zh: 反对看电视的理由，是它可能引发身体或行为方面的问题。

five-t3.en: One concern is that staring at television for long periods may cause eye strain, particularly when they do not take regular breaks.
five-t3.zh: 一个令人担忧的问题是，长时间盯着电视可能造成眼睛疲劳，尤其是在儿童没有定期休息的情况下。

five-t3.en: Such prolonged viewing may also deprive them of outdoor activity time, especially when it becomes a daily habit.
five-t3.zh: 这种长时间观看还可能挤占他们的户外活动时间，特别是当它成为日常习惯时。

five-t3.en: Apart from these physical concerns, violent television content, despite television content rating systems, may also predispose some children to aggressive behaviour.
five-t3.zh: 除了这些身体方面的担忧，尽管存在电视内容分级制度，暴力电视内容仍可能使部分儿童更容易出现攻击行为。

five-t3.en: Children may see fantasy violence in works ranging from Harry Potter to Tom and Jerry.
five-t3.zh: 儿童可能在从《哈利·波特》到《猫和老鼠》等作品中看到虚构的暴力。

five-t3.en: Difficulty distinguishing between fantasy and reality may predispose them to emulating television violence in real life.
five-t3.zh: 难以区分幻想与现实，可能使他们更容易在现实生活中模仿电视中的暴力。

five-t3.en: Others, however, highlight the educational benefits that accrue to children.
five-t3.zh: 然而，另一些人强调电视给儿童带来的教育益处。

five-t3.en: When children are young, parents often encourage them to watch TV, hoping that language learning can be facilitated when children imitate the words and sentences spoken by their favourite characters.
five-t3.zh: 孩子年幼时，家长常常鼓励他们看电视，希望他们模仿喜爱角色说出的单词和句子，从而促进语言学习。

five-t3.en: A good example can be found in parents who aim to help their children become bilingual by using English-language cartoons as one part of their language learning.
five-t3.zh: 一个很好的例子，是一些家长将英语动画片作为儿童语言学习的一部分，希望借此帮助孩子掌握两种语言。

five-t3.en: In addition, children can also gain a better understanding of the world around them by watching television programmes, especially programmes aimed at children that are designed to help them acquire knowledge step by step.
five-t3.zh: 此外，儿童还可以通过电视节目更好地了解周围世界，尤其是那些专门面向儿童、旨在帮助他们逐步获取知识的节目。

five-t3.en: This audio-visual integration can be effective, allowing teachers at primary or secondary schools to use selected clips as a means of imparting knowledge.
five-t3.zh: 这种视听结合可以发挥作用，让中小学教师能将精选片段作为传授知识的手段。

five-t3.en: I think the scale of the problems that can ensue from watching television is sometimes exaggerated.
five-t3.zh: 我认为，看电视可能引发的问题，其严重程度有时被夸大了。

five-t3.en: It is prolonged viewing without screen breaks, rather than television per se, that is problematic; thus, these physical risks can be mitigated by parents’ proper guidance, such as encouraging children to participate in outdoor activity every day and limiting their TV time.
five-t3.zh: 真正有问题的是长时间观看而不让眼睛休息，而不是电视本身；因此，家长可以通过适当指导，例如鼓励儿童每天参加户外活动、限制看电视时间，来缓解这些身体风险。

five-t3.en: As for exposure to aggressive behaviour and the possibility of imitation, discussions of any violence encountered in age-appropriate programmes can be regarded as a vehicle for helping children distinguish fiction from reality and become aware of the possible consequences of such behaviour, while clearly unsuitable content should be avoided.
five-t3.zh: 至于接触攻击行为及可能进行模仿的问题，可以就适龄节目中出现的暴力内容展开讨论，借此帮助儿童区分虚构与现实，并认识到此类行为可能产生的后果，同时应避开明显不适宜的内容。

five-t3.en: In conclusion, when children watch suitable television programmes, their language ability can be developed and they can acquire knowledge by doing so; however, they may suffer from physical and behavioural problems if their viewing is unrestricted.
five-t3.zh: 总之，儿童观看适宜的电视节目时，能够发展语言能力并获取知识；然而，如果不限制观看，他们也可能出现身体和行为方面的问题。

five-t3.en: It is, therefore, my opinion that moderation is the key and that parents and teachers should focus on teaching children to benefit from television rather than allowing unlimited viewing without attention to content.
five-t3.zh: 因此，我认为关键在于适度，家长和教师应着重引导儿童从电视中受益，而不是不关注内容、任由他们无限制地观看。

five-c1.en: One of the growing trends in modern society is that corporations place a premium on the role played by CEOs and accordingly they receive very high salaries; thus, a fierce debate rages over the growing salary disparities between them and other low-ranking workers.
five-c1.zh: 现代社会日益明显的趋势之一，是企业高度重视首席执行官发挥的作用，并因此给予他们很高的薪酬；于是，他们与其他较低层级员工之间日益扩大的薪酬差距，引发了激烈争论。

five-c1.en: Although salaries should be in proportion to performance or contribution, other considerations can justify much higher CEO compensation, provided that it reflects their responsibilities and contribution.
five-c1.zh: 尽管薪酬应与表现或贡献相称，但只要首席执行官的报酬反映其责任和贡献，其他考量也能支持他们获得高得多的薪酬。

five-c1.en: The argument against such high salaries of CEOs is that some are disproportionately rewarded.
five-c1.zh: 反对首席执行官获得如此高薪的理由，是有些人的报酬与其贡献并不相称。

five-c1.en: The salary for employees usually is determined by considering the contribution they make to the company or the responsibility they take on; therefore, executives can receive higher salaries and compensation in the form of stock.
five-c1.zh: 员工的薪酬通常根据他们对公司的贡献或承担的责任来确定，因此高管可以获得更高薪酬，以及股票形式的报酬。

five-c1.en: However, the real problem arises when they are paid much more than their performance warrants; their compensation should be performance-based.
five-c1.zh: 不过，当他们的报酬远超其表现应得的水平时，真正的问题就出现了；他们的薪酬应以绩效为基础。

five-c1.en: The gap can be particularly alarming when executives receive large rewards despite their companies' poor performance.
five-c1.zh: 当高管在公司业绩不佳的情况下仍获得巨额奖励时，这种差距尤其令人担忧。

five-c1.en: Therefore, herein lies the question as to why the pay-for-performance model sometimes fails when it comes to executive salaries.
five-c1.zh: 因此，问题就在于，为什么按绩效付酬的模式在高管薪酬上有时会失效。

five-c1.en: However, this belief overlooks the fact that the contribution made by junior employees is often assessed largely on the basis of their individual work, while the contribution made by a team leader should be assessed in terms of their role in improving the performance of the whole team.
five-c1.zh: 然而，这种看法忽视了一个事实：基层员工的贡献往往主要依据个人工作来评估，而团队领导者的贡献，应根据其在提升整个团队表现方面所发挥的作用来评估。

five-c1.en: This can help to justify much higher executive pay, because their decisions can affect the productivity of an entire workforce.
five-c1.zh: 这有助于说明高管获得高得多的报酬为何合理，因为他们的决策能够影响整支员工队伍的生产率。

five-c1.en: A good example would be a company whose CEO successfully restructures its operations, with higher pay representing recognition of that contribution.
five-c1.zh: 一个很好的例子，是一家公司的首席执行官成功重组业务，而更高的薪酬代表了对这一贡献的认可。

five-c1.en: Moreover, executives of failing companies retain the right to receive what they deserve even if companies are declining due to factors beyond their control.
five-c1.zh: 此外，即使公司因高管无法控制的因素而陷入衰退，经营不善公司的高管仍有权获得其应得的报酬。

five-c1.en: How much CEOs should earn is determined by the board of directors, who use their power to retain talent and maximize returns to company shareholders; therefore, CEOs are paid much more than others because they are believed to have the ability to help secure companies' future success, driving higher productivity, profits, and stock prices.
five-c1.zh: 首席执行官的收入由董事会决定，董事会运用这一权力留住人才，并最大限度地提高股东回报；因此，首席执行官的薪酬远高于其他人，是因为人们相信，他们有能力帮助公司确保未来的成功，带动生产率、利润和股价提升。

five-c1.en: However, talented executives by no means guarantee success; if they fail, they can be fired next year but they should still receive their agreed salary for their work this year, which is a rule that applies to every employee.
five-c1.zh: 不过，有才华的高管绝不意味着一定会成功；如果他们失败，下一年可以被解雇，但仍应获得今年工作所约定的薪酬，而这一规则适用于每一名员工。

five-c1.en: This entitlement does not, however, justify large performance bonuses when their contribution is poor.
five-c1.zh: 然而，如果他们的贡献不佳，这种权利并不能成为获得巨额绩效奖金的理由。

five-c1.en: In conclusion, although salaries should reflect individuals’ contributions, the scale of their responsibilities should also be considered.
five-c1.zh: 总之，尽管薪酬应反映个人贡献，但责任的范围也应纳入考量。

five-c1.en: It is, therefore, my opinion that the high salaries of CEOs can be justified by the scale of their responsibilities and their own contribution, be their companies successful or unsuccessful.
five-c1.zh: 因此，我认为，无论公司成功与否，首席执行官的高薪都可以由其责任范围和自身贡献来证明其合理性。

five-c2.en: There has been a fierce yet unresolved debate as to how to help employees perform better at work.
five-c2.zh: 对于如何帮助员工在工作中表现更好，一直存在激烈而尚无定论的争论。

five-c2.en: It is proposed by some policymakers that this goal can be achieved by entitling employees to at least four weeks of annual leave.
five-c2.zh: 一些政策制定者提议，可以通过赋予员工每年至少四周年假的权利来实现这一目标。

five-c2.en: Such a proposal can be regarded as an efficiency drive despite its apparent disruption to workflow.
five-c2.zh: 尽管这一提议看起来会打乱工作流程，但仍可被视为提升效率的举措。

five-c2.en: The argument in favour of this proposal is that it allows employees to reenergize and thus achieve efficiency gains at work.
five-c2.zh: 支持这项提议的理由，是它能让员工恢复精力，从而提升工作效率。

five-c2.en: When employees work for too long and have no opportunities to rest and recharge themselves, problems arise: overwork can give rise to stress, affect mood, and undermine morale.
five-c2.zh: 当员工工作时间过长，没有机会休息和恢复精力时，就会出现问题：过度工作可能产生压力、影响情绪并削弱士气。

five-c2.en: People who suffer from work-related illnesses may end up resigning due to ill health; therefore, adequate annual leave can help sustain better performance at work.
five-c2.zh: 患上工作相关疾病的人可能最终因健康不佳而辞职，因此充足的年假有助于维持更好的工作表现。

five-c2.en: While the justification for annual leave exists, why do people call for at least four weeks’ holiday?
five-c2.zh: 既然年假有其合理性，为什么人们主张至少休假四周呢？

five-c2.en: Consider employees whose annual leave entitlement is limited to five days.
five-c2.zh: 试想一些员工的年假额度只有五天。

five-c2.en: Often, they would use it intermittently, making individual breaks too short for a sustained period of rest.
five-c2.zh: 他们往往会零散地使用这些假期，导致每次休息都太短，无法形成持续的休养期。

five-c2.en: By contrast, four weeks could allow a two-week break for sustained recovery while leaving another two weeks for shorter breaks throughout the year.
five-c2.zh: 相比之下，四周年假可以让他们安排一次两周的长假来持续恢复精力，同时保留另外两周，用于全年其他较短的休息。

five-c2.en: An extended holiday allows people to rest by doing what they are interested in (e.g., travelling to other countries) and may thus help them perform more efficiently and be more motivated than those who have insufficient time to rest.
five-c2.zh: 较长的假期让人们能够通过做自己感兴趣的事情，例如出国旅游，来休息，因此可能帮助他们比休息时间不足的人工作更高效、更有动力。

five-c2.en: However, not everyone is convinced by this efficiency measure.
five-c2.zh: 不过，并非所有人都信服这一提升效率的措施。

five-c2.en: The critics argue that it may pose a problem to the workflow of the organization, especially when one’s duties can hardly be covered by others.
five-c2.zh: 批评者认为，这可能给组织的工作流程带来问题，尤其是当某人的职责很难由他人代为承担时。

five-c2.en: Nonetheless, this problem can be mitigated: managers should agree with employees on when to take leave and arrange cover in advance, minimizing disruption.
five-c2.zh: 尽管如此，这个问题可以缓解：管理者应与员工商定休假时间，并提前安排替岗，以尽量减少干扰。

five-c2.en: A good example would be a company that staggers staff holidays and trains colleagues to cover essential duties; such arrangements can make a four-week entitlement more viable without requiring employees to take all their leave at once.
five-c2.zh: 一个很好的例子，是公司错峰安排员工休假，并培训同事接手必要职责；这类安排能够让四周年假制度更可行，而不必要求员工一次休完全部假期。

five-c2.en: In conclusion, although it may pose a problem to efficiency gains in the short term, an entitlement to at least four weeks' holiday offers a reasonable minimum for combining sustained recovery with regular breaks.
five-c2.zh: 总之，尽管在短期内可能对效率提升造成问题，但至少四周的休假权利，为兼顾持续恢复精力与经常休息提供了一个合理的最低标准。

five-c2.en: It can therefore support better performance at work, provided that staffing and scheduling are properly managed.
five-c2.zh: 因此，只要人员配置和排班得到妥善管理，它就能支持更好的工作表现。

five-c3.en: The contribution made by businesses to economic development is undeniable; however, it is argued that they should also contribute to society by shouldering more responsibility.
five-c3.zh: 企业对经济发展的贡献不可否认；不过，有人主张，企业也应通过承担更多责任来为社会作出贡献。

five-c3.en: Businesses should never care only about profits even though their core aim is money-making.
five-c3.zh: 即使企业的核心目标是盈利，也绝不应只关心利润。

five-c3.en: The argument in favour of this is that businesses should and can operate in the interests of society as a whole.
five-c3.zh: 支持这一观点的理由，是企业应该、也能够为整个社会的利益开展经营。

five-c3.en: The core aim of a business is profitability; such a money-making goal is achieved by serving its clients and depends on the stability and prosperity of society.
five-c3.zh: 企业的核心目标是盈利；这一盈利目标要通过服务客户来实现，并依赖社会的稳定与繁荣。

five-c3.en: Businesses, therefore, should embrace the responsibility not only to help contribute to society but also to help themselves succeed in the long term.
five-c3.zh: 因此，企业应承担责任，不仅为社会作出贡献，也帮助自身取得长远成功。

five-c3.en: A good example can be found in restaurants, the success of which ultimately rests on providing safe food that meets consumers' needs.
five-c3.zh: 餐厅就是一个很好的例子，其成功最终取决于提供安全、符合消费者需求的食品。

five-c3.en: In addition, any company embracing social responsibility can act in many ways, including philanthropy, fair labour practices, and environmental protection, among others.
five-c3.zh: 此外，任何承担社会责任的公司都可以通过慈善、公平用工和环境保护等多种方式采取行动。

five-c3.en: For example, a technology company could donate money to help those who suffer in a natural disaster; a coffee company could commit to social responsibility by supporting sustainable farming in the regions where its ingredients are sourced; and a manufacturer could demonstrate concern for employee welfare by paying employees in proportion to their efforts and maintaining safe working conditions.
five-c3.zh: 例如，科技公司可以捐款帮助遭受自然灾害的人；咖啡公司可以通过支持原料产地的可持续农业来履行社会责任；制造商则可以根据员工的付出支付相称的报酬，并维持安全的工作环境，以此体现对员工福祉的关心。

five-c3.en: These examples show that businesses have both reasons and practical means to fulfil their social responsibilities.
five-c3.zh: 这些例子表明，企业既有履行社会责任的理由，也有切实可行的手段。

five-c3.en: However, not everyone finds this convincing, arguing that business, by its very nature, should solely concentrate on money-making activities.
five-c3.zh: 不过，并非所有人都认同这一点，他们认为企业的本质就是应只专注于盈利活动。

five-c3.en: From this perspective, businesses should be free to decide whether to support charitable causes.
five-c3.zh: 从这个角度看，企业应有权自由决定是否支持慈善事业。

five-c3.en: Can we blame those businesses that haven’t donated their money to help others in need?
five-c3.zh: 我们能责怪那些没有捐钱帮助有需要者的企业吗？

five-c3.en: Not necessarily.
five-c3.zh: 未必。

five-c3.en: Can we blame those businesses whose operations are taking a toll on the environment?
five-c3.zh: 我们能责怪那些经营活动正在损害环境的企业吗？

five-c3.en: Here, the answer is different, since such damage imposes costs on others.
five-c3.zh: 在这里，答案就不同了，因为这种损害会让他人承担成本。

five-c3.en: However, profit need not be the only goal of commercial activity.
five-c3.zh: 不过，利润不必是商业活动的唯一目标。

five-c3.en: Social responsibility can be practised by a wide range of companies.
five-c3.zh: 各种各样的公司都可以践行社会责任。

five-c3.en: Members of younger generations, such as millennials and Gen Z, who value social responsibility can drive change in the workplace as workers and in their daily lives as consumers, all of which can contribute to greater business success.
five-c3.zh: 千禧一代和Z世代等年轻一代中重视社会责任的人，既可以作为员工在工作场所推动改变，也可以作为消费者在日常生活中推动改变，而这些都有助于企业取得更大的成功。

five-c3.en: In conclusion, although enterprises are primarily concerned with making money, they should also assume more social responsibilities not only to reduce harm and support society but also to create a good image and earn customer trust.
five-c3.zh: 总之，尽管企业主要关注盈利，但也应承担更多社会责任，不仅要减少危害、支持社会，还要树立良好形象、赢得客户信任。

five-c3.en: Responsible businesses can help society thrive, while a prosperous society can support business success.
five-c3.zh: 负责任的企业能够帮助社会繁荣，而繁荣的社会也能够支持企业取得成功。

five-r1.en: Voluntary work often wins praise from others.
five-r1.zh: 志愿服务常常赢得他人的赞扬。

five-r1.en: With this comes a proposal whereby all young adults should be required to do unpaid community work.
five-r1.zh: 由此产生了一项提议，要求所有年轻成年人都从事无偿社区服务。

five-r1.en: Despite its tangible benefits, I believe the drawbacks of requiring all young adults to participate would be greater.
five-r1.zh: 尽管这种服务具有切实的好处，但我认为，要求所有年轻成年人参加的弊端会更大。

five-r1.en: The argument in favour of this policy is that the benefits accrue to young people themselves and the community.
five-r1.zh: 支持这项政策的理由，是年轻人自身和社区都能受益。

five-r1.en: For young adults, they are able to experience a deep sense of satisfaction by helping others and develop interpersonal skills when they are interacting with local people.
five-r1.zh: 对年轻成年人而言，帮助他人能让他们获得深切的满足感，与当地居民互动也能培养人际交往能力。

five-r1.en: For the community, people living in the community can be supported by these volunteers, under appropriate supervision, in obtaining the right services when needed, be they housing support or child protection.
five-r1.zh: 对社区而言，在适当监督下，这些志愿者可以帮助社区居民在有需要时获得合适的服务，无论是住房支持还是儿童保护服务。

five-r1.en: This can create a win-win situation.
However, such benefits cannot justify the proposal to make community work mandatory for all.
five-r1.zh: 然而，这些好处并不足以支持强制所有人参加社区服务的提议。

five-r1.en: Although young adults can benefit from such community work, problems arise when a moral obligation becomes a compulsory requirement, which may lead to resentment: young adults may fulfil all the requirements but avoid volunteering in future.
five-r1.zh: 尽管年轻成年人能够从这类社区工作中受益，但当道德义务变成强制要求时，就可能产生问题、引发反感：年轻人可能完成所有规定任务，却在将来不愿再做志愿者。

five-r1.en: In addition, the community will not necessarily benefit more simply because there are more community workers, since some services and support require relevant experience or qualifications.
five-r1.zh: 此外，社区工作人员增加，并不必然让社区获得更多益处，因为部分服务和支持需要相关经验或资格。

five-r1.en: A better option would be to encourage more people, rather than require all, to do unpaid community work with suitable training.
five-r1.zh: 更好的选择，是在提供适当培训的前提下，鼓励更多人从事无偿社区服务，而不是要求所有人都参加。

five-r1.en: In conclusion, although intuitively young people should do unpaid community work, the proposal to require all to do so risks being counterproductive and impractical.
five-r1.zh: 总之，尽管直觉上年轻人应该从事无偿社区服务，但要求所有人都这样做，可能适得其反，也不切实际。

five-r1.en: Its drawbacks outweigh its benefits, since voluntary participation can retain many of the gains without imposing the same obligation on unwilling participants.
five-r1.zh: 其弊大于利，因为自愿参与能够保留许多益处，同时不必对不愿参加的人施加同样的义务。

five-r1.en: Society should continue to call for more people to help while allowing young adults to volunteer of their own volition.
five-r1.zh: 社会应继续号召更多人提供帮助，同时允许年轻成年人出于自身意愿参与志愿服务。

five-r2.en: Globalization has promoted migration flows, which are often driven by career opportunities.
five-r2.zh: 全球化促进了人口跨境流动，而这种流动往往由职业机会所驱动。

five-r2.en: With the prospect of greater personal fulfilment comes a belief that professionals (e.g., doctors and engineers) should be free to embark on their careers abroad, whereas others argue that the well-educated workforce should stay and contribute to the countries where they completed their training.
five-r2.zh: 获得更大个人成就感的前景，使人们认为医生、工程师等专业人士应有自由到海外开展职业生涯；另一些人则主张，受过良好教育的劳动力应留在完成培训的国家，为其作出贡献。

five-r2.en: Both views are discussed here, but I favour freedom of choice.
five-r2.zh: 下文将讨论这两种观点，但我更支持选择自由。

five-r2.en: The primary justification for a restriction on where these professionals should work resides in the belief that they should dedicate themselves to the countries where educational and vocational training was afforded to them, particularly when it was publicly funded.
five-r2.zh: 限制这些专业人士工作地点的主要依据，是认为他们应为给予自己教育和职业培训的国家奉献力量，尤其是在培训由公共资金资助的情况下。

five-r2.en: Modern society places a premium on an educated workforce and the university disciplines that help to develop it (e.g., medicine, IT, and engineering); thus, public investment in these disciplines can pay off more directly when these well-trained professionals are working for local communities.
five-r2.zh: 现代社会高度重视受过教育的劳动力，以及有助于培养这些人才的医学、信息技术、工程等大学学科；因此，当这些训练有素的专业人士为当地社区工作时，对这些学科的公共投资就能更直接地获得回报。

five-r2.en: If professionals go abroad after being trained, such brain drain can mean that countries, industries and organizations lose valuable skilled workers, depriving these countries of some opportunities for development.
five-r2.zh: 如果专业人士受训后移居海外，这种人才流失可能意味着国家、行业和组织失去宝贵的技术人才，使这些国家失去部分发展机会。

five-r2.en: Others, however, highlight freedom of career choice: every individual should be free to pursue a successful life, be it personal or professional.
five-r2.zh: 然而，另一些人强调职业选择的自由：每个人都应有权追求成功的人生，无论是在个人生活还是职业方面。

five-r2.en: Human capital flight can occur when talented professionals suffer from bleak career prospects, poor quality of life, limited access to health care, and a shortage of economic opportunity, among others.
five-r2.zh: 当有才华的专业人士面临暗淡的职业前景、较低的生活质量、有限的医疗服务，以及经济机会不足等问题时，就可能出现人才外流。

five-r2.en: Such factors may prompt skilled and talented workers to leave source countries for places that offer better career opportunities and higher standards of living.
five-r2.zh: 这些因素可能促使有技能、有才华的劳动者离开来源国，前往职业机会更好、生活水平更高的地方。

five-r2.en: I think it should be a moral duty rather than a blanket legal requirement for individuals to devote effort to helping the country that trained them flourish and realize all its potential.
five-r2.zh: 我认为，个人努力帮助培养自己的国家繁荣发展、充分实现潜力，应是一项道德责任，而不应成为一刀切的法律要求。
